entries.title: The College Online Systems
entries.text: You will listen to a meeting at Aberdeen College where people are discussing the college’s new online systems. Listen to the meeting and fill in the missing information in the spaces provided in the note sheet. One has been done for you as an example. Meeting about The College Online Systems Date of meeting: 11th June Present Person Role Mr. Jack Law ICT Teacher Mr. Rob Lee College Technician Ms. Cherry Tam Current system — comments System Comments website not Intranet (example) for teachers to communicate with each other can send advantage: New system — possible features Feature Description social network a place for to chat for buying & selling things, e.g. Action to be taken Action Person contact website designer survey students survey teachers Next meeting: Narrator Task 1. You will listen to a meeting at Aberdeen College where people are discussing the College's 任務一。你將聆聽 Aberdeen College 的一場會議，與會者正在討論學院的 Narrator new online systems. Listen to the meeting and fill in the missing information in the 新網上系統。請聆聽會議，並填寫所缺資料。 Narrator question for you as an example. You now have 30 seconds to study the task. 其中一項已作例子提供。你現在有三十秒時間閱讀題目。 Narrator At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers. 任務結束後，你將有一分鐘時間整理答案。 College meeting OK, good morning everybody. Thanks for coming to the meeting today. I know today's Saturday 好，各位早安。謝謝大家今天來開會。我知道今天是星期六， College meeting and I'm sure you've got other things to do on a Saturday morning, 也相信你們星期六早上有其他事情要做， College meeting but hopefully the meeting will be a short one. Do you two know each other? 不過希望這場會議不會太長。你們兩位認識對方嗎？ College meeting No, I don't think so. 不，我想我們不認識。 College meeting OK, well, this is Rob Lee. Rob's the College Technician, so he can advise us on technical matters. 好，這位是 Rob Lee。Rob 是學院的技術員，可以就技術問題給我們意見。 College meeting And Rob? Rob？ College meeting Hi. 你好。 College meeting Hi. 你好。 College meeting Yeah. And Rob, I think you know Cherry, our student president. 對，Rob，我想你認識我們的學生會主席 Cherry。 College meeting OK. Right, so as I said in my email, I wanted to discuss what needs to be done to improve 好。正如我在電郵所說，我想討論需要做些什麼，來改善 College meeting the College's online systems. So maybe we could start with the College website. 學院的網上系統。不如先談學院網站。 College meeting Any comments from students about the website? 學生對網站有什麼意見？ College meeting Well, the first thing I've written here about the website is that it's like boring. 嗯，我在這裡記下關於網站的第一點，就是它很沉悶。 College meeting Students are always saying that. 學生總是這樣說。 College meeting Yeah, I agree with Cherry actually. It's a bit boring. 對，其實我同意 Cherry。它是有點沉悶。 College meeting I think the thing that I would add would be that it's not user friendly. 我還想補充，它不容易使用。 College meeting Yeah, I'd agree. It certainly isn't user friendly. 對，我同意。它的確不容易使用。 College meeting What about the other services, like the intranet system for teachers? 其他服務又如何，例如供教師使用的內聯網系統？ College meeting Intranet? Is that like where the teachers can communicate with each other? 內聯網？就是教師互相溝通的地方嗎？ College meeting Yeah, the teachers can use the intranet to send files as well, like documents, 對，教師也可以用內聯網傳送檔案，例如文件、 College meeting pictures, video clips. 圖片及短片。 College meeting Why don't they just use their email? 為什麼他們不直接用電郵？ College meeting Because it isn't secure. You know, it's not safe to send files like that. 因為那樣不安全。那樣傳送檔案並不安全。 College meeting And the intranet has the advantage that it's secure because it's protected by the College's firewall. 內聯網的優點是安全，因為受到學院防火牆保護。 College meeting OK, let's move on. What kinds of things would we like to see available online from the new system? 好，繼續吧。我們希望新系統提供哪些網上功能？ College meeting Well, I think a social network. You know, something like Facebook. 我想要一個社交網絡，像 Facebook 那樣。 College meeting Maybe a place where we could chat online about school stuff with schoolmates and teachers. 也許有個地方，讓我們跟同學和教師在網上聊學校的事情。 College meeting Wait, so you would want teachers to be able to go to this social network as well? 等等，所以你希望教師也能進入這個社交網絡？ College meeting As well as students, I mean. 我的意思是，除了學生以外。 College meeting Sure, why not? 當然，為什麼不呢？ College meeting OK, well, that's one idea. What else? 好，這是一個建議。還有呢？ College meeting How about an online market? 網上市集如何？ College meeting What? Like for people to buy and sell things? 什麼？就是供大家買賣東西的地方？ College meeting Yeah, a market. I was thinking, you know, we could like sell things like our old textbooks 對，市集。我想我們可以出售舊課本之類的東西， College meeting and students in lower forms could buy them. 讓低年級學生購買。 College meeting Sounds good. I think that would work. 聽起來不錯。我想這行得通。 College meeting Right, OK, let's move on to the action we need to take. 好，現在談談我們需要採取的行動。 College meeting First, the website. Can you be responsible for that, Rob? 首先是網站。Rob，你可以負責嗎？ College meeting For what? The redesign of the website. 負責什麼？重新設計網站。 College meeting Well, my programming skills. I mean, they're pretty basic. 嗯，我的程式編寫技巧其實很基本。 College meeting But I know a web designer, so I could contact him. 不過我認識一位網頁設計師，可以聯絡他。 College meeting Maybe, you know, to give us a price. 也許請他報個價。 College meeting OK, right. So you contact the web designer then, Rob. 好，那麼 Rob，你就聯絡那位網頁設計師。 College meeting How about the other systems we talked about? 剛才談過的其他系統呢？ College meeting Well, why don't I carry out a survey of the students 不如由我向學生做一項調查， College meeting to see what it is they want from our online systems? 了解他們想我們的網上系統提供什麼？ College meeting Great idea, Cherry. It's really important that we get the students' views on this. 好主意，Cherry。了解學生的意見很重要。 College meeting I think a survey of the students is an excellent idea. 我認為向學生做調查是非常好的主意。 College meeting So, yeah, you can do that, Cherry. 所以，對，就由你做吧，Cherry。 College meeting Fine. 好。 College meeting And I'll do the same with the teachers. 我會向教師做同樣的調查。 College meeting We need to get their input as well. 我們也需要他們的意見。 College meeting So a survey's good. 所以調查是好方法。 College meeting Right, OK, so that's about all we can do today. 好，今天能做的大概就是這些。 College meeting Let's meet again next week, at the same time. 我們下星期同一時間再開會吧。 College meeting I'm sorry. I think I'll need more time than a week. 對不起，我想我需要超過一星期。 College meeting Can we meet in two weeks' time? 可以在兩星期後開會嗎？ College meeting OK, two weeks it is then. 好，就兩星期後吧。 Narrator That is the end of task one. 任務一完結。 Narrator You now have one minute to tidy up your answers. 你現在有一分鐘時間整理答案。 學院的網上系統 你將聆聽 Aberdeen College 的一場會議，與會者會討論學院的新網上系統。請聆聽會議，在筆記表空格填上所缺資料。其中一項已作例子提供。 關於學院網上系統的會議 會議日期： ，六月十一日。 出席者。欄目：姓名／職位。Jack Law 先生：資訊及通訊科技教師。Rob Lee 先生：學院技術員。Cherry Tam 女士： 。 現有系統——意見。欄目：系統／意見。網站： ；不 。內聯網（例子）：供教師互相溝通；可以傳送 ；優點： 。 新系統——可能提供的功能。欄目：功能／說明。社交網絡：供 聊天的地方。 ：供買賣東西，例如 。 需要採取的行動。欄目：行動／負責人。聯絡網頁設計師： 。調查學生意見： 。調查教師意見： 。 下次會議： 。

entries.title: Aberdeen College website
entries.text: You will listen to a presentation by Dannie Wan describing some of the features of the new website to Mr. Law, Rob Lee and Cherry Tam. Listen to the presentation and fill in the missing information in the spaces provided on the website pages. One has been done for you as an example. AC · Academic & Charitable Aberdeen College 🔍 ━━━━━━━━━ Home Students Extra-Curricular Activities Sports Day (example) A recent visit Upcoming Events View upcoming events on our interactive calendar >> Read our previous news stories in our news archive >> > College Wins Cup > comments on college, etc. A Warm Welcome On behalf of the staff and Board of Governors I would like to extend to you a very warm welcome to our school. We aim to provide a happy and caring environment for learning, and to promote the skills which are required by a rapidly changing world. Enjoy browsing our website. We look forward to meeting you soon. Regards Dr. Catherine Lai (Principal) Website design by Maracas Computing · © Aberdeen College · enquiries@ac.edu.hk AC · Academic & Charitable Aberdeen College Students Farewell to Mr. Ingles School Orchestra Debating Society Section Menu Canteen ACquaint Library ACquaint ACquaint is your social space. Here, you can ✓ share content ✓ ✓ Website design by Maracas Computing · © Aberdeen College · enquiries@ac.edu.hk Narrator Task two. 任務二。 Narrator You will listen to a presentation by Danny Won 你將聆聽 Dannie Wan 的簡報， Narrator describing some of the features of the new website 他會介紹新網站的一些功能， Narrator to Mr Law, Rob Lee and Cherry Tam. 對象是 Law 老師、Rob Lee 和 Cherry Tam。 Narrator Listen to the presentation and fill in the missing information 請聆聽簡報，填上所缺資料， Narrator in the spaces provided on the website pages. 填在網站頁面上提供的空格內。 Narrator One has been done for you as an example. 其中一項已作例子提供。 Narrator You now have 30 seconds to study the task. 你現在有三十秒時間閱讀題目。 Narrator At the end of the task, you will have one minute 任務結束後，你將有一分鐘時間 Narrator to tidy up your answers. 整理答案。 Dannie Wan／與會者 OK, if you're ready, Danny, you can start now. 好，Dannie，如果準備好了，可以開始。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Thanks, Rob. 謝謝，Rob。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And thanks to Mr Law and Cherry for coming to my presentation. 也謝謝 Law 老師和 Cherry 來聽我的簡報。 Dannie Wan／與會者 I'm going to show you our first draft design 我會展示第一版設計草稿， Dannie Wan／與會者 for the new college website. 就是學院的新網站。 Dannie Wan／與會者 It's still a bit rough, but I hope you can get the idea. 它還有點粗糙，不過希望大家能明白構思。 Dannie Wan／與會者 To start with, on the screen here, you can see the homepage 首先，螢幕上展示的是網站首頁， Dannie Wan／與會者 of the website with the college logo in the top left corner 左上角有學院標誌， Dannie Wan／與會者 and the name of the college, of course. 當然還有學院的名稱。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Then on the right is a box labelled search 右邊有一個標示「搜尋」的方格， Dannie Wan／與會者 for people to search the site using keywords. 讓大家用關鍵字搜尋網站。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And they can search anywhere in the site? 他們可以搜尋網站內任何部分？ Dannie Wan／與會者 Yeah, that's right, Mr Law. 對，Law 老師，沒錯。 Dannie Wan／與會者 OK, so on the next row down from left to right, 好，下一行由左至右， Dannie Wan／與會者 we have the tabs for the individual pages of the website. 是網站各個頁面的分頁標籤。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The homepage, which is the one we're on now. 首頁，就是我們目前所在的頁面。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Then there's a page called About Us, 然後有一頁叫「關於我們」， Dannie Wan／與會者 where you have all the information about the college, 列出學院的所有資料， Dannie Wan／與會者 including its history, its mission, the staff, and so on. 包括歷史、使命、教職員等等。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And then we have the Students page, which I'll come to later. 接着是「學生」頁面，我稍後會介紹。 Dannie Wan／與會者 A page for parents, so that they can get information 還有「家長」頁面，讓他們取得 Dannie Wan／與會者 about the college from their perspective. 從家長角度需要了解的學院資料。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Then we have a Subjects page, which will include things 接着是「科目」頁面，當中會包括 Dannie Wan／與會者 like the course outlines. 課程大綱之類的資料。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And finally, there's a page for extracurricular activities. 最後是「課外活動」頁面。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Ooh, they're nice photos below that. 下面的相片真漂亮。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Yeah, I just used ones from the old website. 對，我用了舊網站的相片。 Dannie Wan／與會者 You can see three just now, but it's actually a gallery of 12, 目前看到三張，但相簿其實有十二張， Dannie Wan／與會者 which will change every five seconds. 每五秒更換一次。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The captions below will change as well. 下方的相片說明也會更換。 Dannie Wan／與會者 At present, I've put up three photos and called them Sports Day. 目前我放了三張相片，其中一張叫「運動會」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The one in the middle, I've called Study at AC. 中間那張，我叫它「在 AC 學習」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And the other one is A Recent Visit. 另一張是「最近一次探訪」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Is that you, Cherry, in the Study at AC photo? Cherry，「在 AC 學習」那張相片裡的是你嗎？ Dannie Wan／與會者 Yeah, that's me holding up my hand. 對，舉手的就是我。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Right, moving on. 好，繼續。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Now, on the left of the page, left of the welcome message 現在看頁面左邊，也就是校長歡迎辭的 Dannie Wan／與會者 from the principal, you can see three separate boxes. 左邊，可以看到三個獨立的方格。 Dannie Wan／與會者 These are for important information that you want your visitors to see first. 這些用來展示你希望訪客首先看到的重要資料。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The first is for upcoming events. 第一個是「即將舉行的活動」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 People can simply click on the link and go to the interactive calendar. 只要點擊連結，就能前往互動行事曆。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Then next is the Latest News section. 下一個是「最新消息」部分。 Dannie Wan／與會者 You can see that I've added in a link to a story. 可以看到我加了一則新聞的連結。 Dannie Wan／與會者 College Wins Cup? 「學院贏得獎盃」？ Dannie Wan／與會者 Yes, I just made that up as a demonstration. 對，我只是編來作示範。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Actually, the college has just won the District Handball Cup, so it's right. 其實學院剛贏了區際手球盃，所以說得沒錯。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Excellent. 太好了。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Right, where was I? 我剛才說到哪裡？ Dannie Wan／與會者 Right, the next one. 對，下一個。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Well, again, this is just a demo. 這個也只是示範。 Dannie Wan／與會者 I called this one Have Your Say. 我把它叫作「發表你的意見」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 It could be a link to a place where students and teachers can make comments on the college. 它可以連結到一個地方，讓學生和教師就學院發表意見。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Hmm, Have Your Say. 嗯，「發表你的意見」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 I like the sound of it, but I'm not sure I'd like what the students might post there. 聽起來不錯，但我不肯定自己會喜歡學生在那裡貼的內容。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Hmm, okay. 嗯，好。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And that's about it for the home page. 首頁大概就是這樣。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Good. 好。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Have you had time to work on any of the other pages? 你有時間設計其他頁面嗎？ Dannie Wan／與會者 Yeah, okay. 有，好。 Dannie Wan／與會者 We've been working on the students page. 我們一直在製作學生頁面。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Just a second. 等一下。 Dannie Wan／與會者 So here it is. 就是這裡。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The students page. 學生頁面。 Dannie Wan／與會者 There will be all the same things at the top of the page, as on the home page. 頁面頂部的內容會跟首頁相同。 Dannie Wan／與會者 So I haven't included them on the demo. 所以我沒有把它們放進示範版本。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Oh, you can see three different photos here. 這裡可以看到三張不同的相片。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Okay. 好。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The difference is in the menus on the left side of the page, 不同的地方是頁面左邊的選單， Dannie Wan／與會者 where you can see that we have various links to places in the site 可以看到通往網站各部分的連結， Dannie Wan／與會者 that will be of interest to the students. 都是學生感興趣的地方。 Dannie Wan／與會者 So we have transport at the top of the list. 清單最上方是「交通」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Good. 好。 Dannie Wan／與會者 If the students can't get here, then you can't teach them very much, can you? 如果學生無法來到這裡，你也教不了他們多少，對吧？ Dannie Wan／與會者 That's what I always say. 我總是這樣說。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Yes, so transport. 對，所以是「交通」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And then we have canteen. 然後是「食堂」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The next one's something quite new. 下一項是相當新的東西。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And this is the Acquaint, the social networking facility that we have introduced. 就是我們引入的社交網絡設施 ACquaint。 Dannie Wan／與會者 It's still in production, so we can't show it to you yet. 它仍在製作中，所以暫時不能展示。 Dannie Wan／與會者 But users will be able to access it from here. 不過用戶將能從這裡進入。 Dannie Wan／與會者 I've just included some examples of what you could do with Acquaint. 我列了幾個例子，說明可以用 ACquaint 做什麼。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The examples I've put here are share content, 這裡列出的例子有分享內容、 Dannie Wan／與會者 meet new friends, 結識新朋友， Dannie Wan／與會者 and maybe the most important, build relationships. 以及可能是最重要的：建立人際關係。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Yep, looks good. 對，看起來不錯。 Dannie Wan／與會者 That last one, build relationships. 最後那一點，建立人際關係。 Dannie Wan／與會者 It'd be really good if we could use the website to build relationships, 如果我們能利用網站建立人際關係，那就很好， Dannie Wan／與會者 you know, between students and students and between students and teachers. 例如學生彼此之間，以及學生與教師之間的關係。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Yeah. 對。 Dannie Wan／與會者 So the other major thing we've included on the menu, 所以我們在選單中加入的另一個主要項目， Dannie Wan／與會者 on the students page, is academe. 是在學生頁面上的 Academe。 Dannie Wan／與會者 The new learning management system. 就是新的學習管理系統。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Acco... 「Acco……」 Dannie Wan／與會者 What? 什麼？ Dannie Wan／與會者 Accadeen. 「Academe」。 Dannie Wan／與會者 A, C, A, D, E, M, E. 拼作 A、C、A、D、E、M、E。 Dannie Wan／與會者 It means the academic or learning environment, 它的意思是學術或學習環境， Dannie Wan／與會者 and also begins with AC for Aberdeen College. 也以 AC 開頭，代表 Aberdeen College。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Oh yeah, very good. 啊，對，很好。 Dannie Wan／與會者 And again, we're working on that and hope to have it ready for you to see soon. 這個也還在製作，希望很快能準備好，展示給大家看。 Dannie Wan／與會者 So after academe, we have a link to the library, Academe 之後，有通往圖書館的連結， Dannie Wan／與會者 and then two links are to the dreaded examinations. 再來是兩個通往可怕的考試資料的連結。 Dannie Wan／與會者 We have separate links to exam information and exam results. 我們把「考試資訊」和「考試成績」分成兩個連結。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Yeah. 對。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Well, exams are on everybody's minds. 大家都很關心考試。 Dannie Wan／與會者 So, good. 所以，很好。 Dannie Wan／與會者 Yeah. 對。 Dannie Wan／與會者 We can provide the information here. 我們可以在這裡提供資訊。 Dannie Wan／與會者 I don't know what you're looking so worried about, Cherry. entries.text: Cherry is now talking to a group of Form 5 and 6 students about the college’s online systems and issues about studying online. Views on online learning Name of student View (choose one) Ways of learning mentioned Grace Yau listening and talking to teachers (example) listening and talking to classmates video conferencing Michael Ong reading sharing information with classmates getting teachers’ advice According to Grace, what do students do that makes social networking sites like Facebook dangerous? Posting personal information, e.g. and Saying yes to According to Grace, why are some students not careful enough when using social networking sites? According to Michael, what should the school do? Narrator Task three. 任務三。 Narrator Cherry is now talking to a group of form five and six students Cherry 現在正與一群中五和中六學生交談， Narrator about the college's online systems and issues about studying online. 討論學院的網上系統及網上學習的相關問題。 Narrator Complete the information in the spaces provided as you listen. 請一邊聆聽，一邊在空格填寫資料。 Narrator One has been done for you as an example. 其中一項已作例子提供。 Narrator You now have 30 seconds to study the task. 你現在有三十秒時間閱讀題目。 Narrator At the end of the task, you will have one and a half minutes to tidy up your answers. 任務結束後，你將有一分半鐘時間整理答案。 Students and Cherry Okay. 好。 Students and Cherry Thanks everyone for coming. 謝謝大家前來。 Students and Cherry I hope you don't mind me recording this. 希望你們不介意我錄下這次討論。 Students and Cherry Perhaps we can start with everybody saying a little bit 不如先請大家簡單說說， Students and Cherry about what they think the main issues are about. 你們認為主要的問題是什麼， Students and Cherry You know, studying online at Aberdeen College. 就是在 Aberdeen College 進行網上學習這方面。 Students and Cherry Right. 好。 Students and Cherry Well, I can start. 那我先開始。 Students and Cherry I think I should say from the outset that there's no way you can replace real learning 首先我想說，真正在課室裡的學習，根本不可能 Students and Cherry in the classroom with reading from websites and watching videos on YouTube. 由閱讀網站和看 YouTube 影片來取代。 Students and Cherry Sorry. 不好意思。 Students and Cherry Can you introduce yourself? 可以先介紹自己嗎？ Students and Cherry Oh, sorry. 啊，不好意思。 Students and Cherry I'm Grace Yao from 5C. 我是 5C 班的 Grace Yau。 Students and Cherry Okay. 好。 Students and Cherry Grace, please go on. Grace，請繼續。 Students and Cherry You were saying that learning online can't replace classroom learning. 你剛才說，網上學習不能取代課堂學習。 Students and Cherry Yeah. 對。 Students and Cherry I mean, learning is meant to be interactive, right? 學習應該是互動的，對吧？ Students and Cherry We learn from teachers and we learn from classmates. 我們向教師學習，也向同學學習。 Students and Cherry We learn by listening to people who know more than us like the teacher 我們聆聽比自己懂得更多的人，例如教師，從而學習， Students and Cherry and by talking to people who are learning along with us. 也透過與一起學習的人交談來學習。 Students and Cherry We also learn by doing things like in science, we learn by doing experiments 我們也會從實作中學習，例如科學課做實驗， Students and Cherry and in art, we learn by creating things. 美術課則透過創作學習。 Students and Cherry You can create things on computers as well. 電腦上也能進行創作。 Students and Cherry Yeah, but it's not the same dough, is it? 對，但那並不一樣，對吧？ Students and Cherry I think computers and iPads and iPhones are brilliant for playing games 我覺得電腦、iPad 和 iPhone 用來玩遊戲， Students and Cherry and chatting with our friends and stuff. 或者跟朋友聊天之類，都很棒。 Students and Cherry But it's not real learning, is it? 但那並不是真正的學習，對吧？ Students and Cherry Okay. 好。 Students and Cherry Maybe you can tell us more about what you think. 不如你再詳細說說自己的想法。 Students and Cherry What's your name again? 你叫什麼名字？ Students and Cherry Me. 我？ Students and Cherry My name's Icarus Liu. 我叫 Icarus Liu。 Students and Cherry Icarus. Icarus。 Students and Cherry That's an unusual name. 這個名字很特別。 Students and Cherry How do you spell that? 怎樣拼寫？ Students and Cherry I, C, A, R, U, S, Icarus, U, L, I, U. I、C、A、R、U、S，Icarus；Liu，L、I、U。 Students and Cherry Okay, Icarus. 好，Icarus。 Students and Cherry What do you think? 你怎麼看？ Students and Cherry Well, I mean, we all have computers at home and a lot of students have laptops as well. 我們家裡都有電腦，很多學生也有手提電腦。 Students and Cherry So we can all access online learning materials. 所以我們都能取得網上學習材料。 Students and Cherry So I think we should be using that environment to learn much more than we do. 因此我認為，我們應該比現在更多地利用這個環境學習。 Students and Cherry To be honest, I learn more at home than at school. 老實說，我在家裡學到的比在學校更多。 Students and Cherry That's quite a bold statement there, Icarus. Icarus，這說法相當大膽。 Students and Cherry Yeah. 對。 Students and Cherry I mean, there's lots of ways we can learn online. 網上學習有很多方式。 Students and Cherry We can use video conferencing to talk to people. 我們可以用視像會議跟別人交談， Students and Cherry And we can use all kinds of creative software. 也可以用各種創意軟件。 Students and Cherry What do you mean, creative software? 你說的創意軟件是什麼意思？ Students and Cherry Creative software, you know, to draw or design things. 就是用來繪畫或者設計東西的創意軟件。 Students and Cherry Oh, right. 哦，明白。 Students and Cherry Okay. 好。 Students and Cherry Right. 好。 Students and Cherry Maybe I'll ask somebody else. 不如問問其他人。 Students and Cherry Yes. 是。 Students and Cherry Yeah. 對。 Students and Cherry Hi, I'm Michael Ong from 6B. 大家好，我是 6B 班的 Michael Ong。 Students and Cherry Obviously, I haven't thought about this as much as grace and Icarus. 顯然，我沒有像 Grace 和 Icarus 那樣深入想過這件事。 Students and Cherry I'm still not sure about all this really. 其實我對這一切仍未有確定看法。 Students and Cherry I mean, I can now be reading, you know, a book or whatever. 例如，我現在讀一本書或其他東西時， Students and Cherry And I can look up any words I don't know on an online dictionary instantly 可以即時用網上字典查閱不認識的字， Students and Cherry and learn that way. 從中學習。 Students and Cherry But I still want to share what I've learned with my classmates as well 但我仍然想與同學分享所學， Students and Cherry and get my teachers advised on how to use it. 也想就如何運用所學徵求教師的意見。 Students and Cherry Okay. 好。 Students and Cherry I want to switch the focus of our discussion a little now 現在我想稍微轉換討論焦點， Students and Cherry and ask how you'd feel about having a facility 問問大家對一項設施的看法， Students and Cherry that lets students and teachers communicate with each other. 它能讓學生和教師互相溝通。 Students and Cherry We can do that already through Facebook. 我們已經可以透過 Facebook 這樣做。 Students and Cherry Why not just have a college Facebook page? 何不直接開設學院的 Facebook 專頁？ Students and Cherry That's an option we've talked about. 這是我們討論過的其中一個選項。 Students and Cherry Do you think it would be a good idea? 你覺得是好主意嗎？ Students and Cherry No, I think it's too dangerous. 不，我覺得太危險了。 Students and Cherry Students are too keen to put themselves on Facebook. 學生太急於在 Facebook 展示自己。 Students and Cherry They post all sorts of personal stuff like, I don't know, 他們貼出各種個人資料，例如， Students and Cherry they put up videos of themselves and they give out their phone number. 上載自己的影片，並公開電話號碼。 Students and Cherry I just think it's dangerous. 我就是覺得很危險。 Students and Cherry Dangerous how, Grace? Grace，怎樣危險？ Students and Cherry Because you don't know who's going to be reading all of this personal stuff. 因為你不知道誰會看這些個人資料。 Students and Cherry I mean, if you do post your phone number, it's really stupid. 如果公開自己的電話號碼，實在很不明智。 Students and Cherry Yeah, but you can control who sees your information. 對，但你可以控制誰能看到你的資料。 Students and Cherry I know. 我知道。 Students and Cherry I know you can. 我知道可以。 Students and Cherry But a lot of students just don't bother 但很多學生懶得這樣做， Students and Cherry and they say yes to every friend request, 而且每個交友邀請都接受， Students and Cherry even if they don't know that person. 即使根本不認識對方。 Students and Cherry Okay, fine. 好吧。 Students and Cherry There are always dangers. 危險總會存在。 Students and Cherry I would never give out personal information like my home address or whatever. 我絕不會公開住址之類的個人資料。 Students and Cherry But often people do. 但人們往往會這樣做。 Students and Cherry That's the point. 問題就在這裡。 Students and Cherry I think some students are just too eager to make new friends. 我覺得有些學生只是太急於結識新朋友。 Students and Cherry No, the point is that people need to learn that doing that sort of thing is stupid. 不，重點是大家需要學會，做那種事是愚蠢的。 Students and Cherry Michael? Michael？ Students and Cherry I tend to agree with Icarus. 我比較同意 Icarus。 Students and Cherry Making friends online is one of the great benefits of having an online social network. 在網上交朋友，是社交網絡的一大好處。 Students and Cherry It's part of the reality of the outside world. 這是外面世界的現實生活的一部分。 Students and Cherry The school should get a social network 學校應該建立一個社交網絡， Students and Cherry and then take the opportunity to educate students about the dangers, 然後藉機教育學生認識當中的危險， Students and Cherry not just pretend that the dangers don't exist. 而不是假裝那些危險不存在。 Students and Cherry Totally. 完全同意。 Students and Cherry Yeah. 對。 Students and Cherry Use technology to educate students about the dangers. 利用科技教育學生認識危險。 Students and Cherry Yeah. 對。 Narrator That is the end of task three. 任務三完結。 Narrator You now have one and a half minutes to complete your answers. 你現在有一分半鐘時間完成答案。 學生對網上學習的看法 Cherry 現在正與一群中五和中六學生交談，討論學院的網上系統及網上學習問題。請一邊聆聽，一邊在空格填寫資料。其中一項已作例子提供。 對網上學習的看法。欄目：學生姓名／看法（選一項）／提及的學習方法。看法選項：Positive＝正面；Negative＝負面；Undecided＝尚未決定。Grace Yau： ；聆聽教師及與教師交談（例子）；聆聽同學及與同學交談； ； 。 ： ；視像會議； 。Michael Ong： ；閱讀； ；與同學分享資訊；取得教師意見。 根據 Grace 的說法，學生有哪些行為，令 Facebook 等社交網站變得危險？ 張貼個人資料，例如 及 。接受 。 根據 Grace 的說法，為什麼有些學生使用社交網站時不夠小心？ 根據 Michael 的說法，學校應該做什麼？ ； 。

entries.text: Cherry and her friend Rowland are listening to a podcast about online systems. Complete the information in the spaces provided as you listen. Web-based email defined as being accessed through a . Also reports increase in email usage by . The use of social networking sites has increased . Mark Zuckerberg (Facebook founder) thinks email likely to . Big advantage of Facebook: Can use text, email or instant messaging in . Indicate how Rowland and Cherry feel about what is said on the podcast. Choose ONE for each person. Person Attitude Rowland Cherry Narrator Cherry and her friend Roland are listening to a podcast about online systems. Cherry 和她的朋友 Rowland 正在收聽一個關於網上系統的播客。 Narrator Complete the information in the spaces provided as you listen. 請一邊聆聽，一邊在空格填寫資料。 Narrator Please note that for the summary of the podcast, 請注意，在播客摘要部分，
