two minutes to tidy up your answers. 任務結束後，你將有兩分鐘時間整理答案。 Podcast Do you want to listen to that podcast I was telling you about? 你想聽聽我之前提到的那個播客嗎？ Podcast It's by a guy called Jerry Brooker and he talks. 製作者叫 Jerry Brooker，他談的是， Podcast He's talking about how what the effect is of social networks on people's use of email. 社交網絡如何影響人們使用電郵。 Podcast Cool. 好啊。 Podcast Let's listen. 來聽吧。 Podcast Okay. 好。 Podcast Here we go. 開始了。 Podcast The idea of email becoming extinct anytime soon may seem silly, 說電郵很快會絕跡，可能聽起來很可笑， Podcast but chances are strong that you used web-based email less in 2011 但你在 2011 年使用網頁電郵的次數，很可能比 Podcast than in 2010. 2010 年少。 Podcast A recent report, the 2012 US Digital Year in Review 最近有份報告《2012 年美國數碼年度回顧》， Podcast showed that web-based email usage was down for just about every age group under 55 顯示幾乎所有五十五歲以下年齡組別使用網頁電郵的情況， Podcast from 2010 to 2011 with the 12 to 17 age group 從 2010 到 2011 年都下降，其中十二至十七歲組別 Podcast showing the largest decline at a staggering 59%. 跌幅最大，達到驚人的百分之五十九。 Podcast Web-based email or webmail refers to email access through a browser. 網頁電郵，是指透過瀏覽器存取的電郵。 Podcast So think Gmail, Hotmail, Yahoo Mail, et cetera, 例如 Gmail、Hotmail、Yahoo Mail 等， Podcast as the majority of email usage analyzed in this report. 就是這份報告分析的主要電郵使用情況。 Podcast This means that the groups of people who make up the majority of internet users 這意味着，佔互聯網使用者大多數、 Podcast and have the most experience with email are now actually moving away from the medium. 也最有使用電郵經驗的群體，如今正在離開這種媒介。 Podcast The report also noted that email usage among seniors has increased, 報告亦指出，長者使用電郵的情況增加， Podcast which isn't surprising as a larger percentage of older people today 這並不意外，因為如今接觸過網絡的長者比例， Podcast have had more exposure to the web than their predecessors. 比以前的長者更高。 Podcast The report also went into detail on what sites people spent their time on. 報告也詳細分析大家把時間花在哪些網站。 Podcast It showed time spent on webmail sites declined, 它顯示，花在網頁電郵網站上的時間減少， Podcast while social networking sites has shown a drastic increase. 而社交網站的使用則大幅增加。 Podcast People are spending more time on social networking sites 大家花更多時間在社交網站， Podcast and less time on email sites, and this is good news for social network sites. 花更少時間在電郵網站，這對社交網站是好消息。 Podcast Last fall, Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg predicted the death of email 去年秋天，Facebook 創辦人 Mark Zuckerberg 在推出 Podcast when he introduced Facebook's new messaging interface. Facebook 新訊息介面時，預言電郵將會消亡。 Podcast We don't think that a modern messaging system is going to be email. 「我們不認為現代訊息系統會是電郵。」 Podcast Zuckerberg said at a press conference in San Francisco, Zuckerberg 在三藩市的記者會上說。 Podcast Facebook users are now able to communicate through Facebook Facebook 使用者現在可以透過 Facebook 溝通， Podcast via text, email or instant message, 使用短訊、電郵或即時訊息， Podcast and receive communications from all of these avenues through one news feed. 並在同一個動態消息串接收所有渠道的通訊。 Podcast Users typically value when related information from a variety of channels 用戶通常重視把不同渠道的相關資訊 Podcast is consolidated into one place, 整合在同一個地方， Podcast and that's what Facebook's messaging interface is trying to accomplish for users. 這正是 Facebook 訊息介面想為使用者做到的事。 Podcast Many organizations with well-established IT departments 很多擁有成熟資訊科技部門的機構， Podcast have typically hosted email in-house, 以往一般在機構內部託管電郵， Podcast whereas others, as of lately, have turned to cloud email services, like Gmail. 但最近有些已轉用 Gmail 等雲端電郵服務。 Podcast This switch is attractive, as it simply cuts costs. 這種轉變吸引人，因為能直接減省成本。 Podcast While many companies and large universities are making the switch to cloud-based email services, 很多公司和大型大學正在轉用雲端電郵服務， Podcast will they make another shift towards using social networks to communicate? 它們會否再轉而利用社交網絡溝通呢？ Podcast One social networking system that businesses are turning to is called Collabro Chatter, 企業正在採用的其中一個社交網絡系統，叫 Collabro Chatter， Podcast a business collaboration tool which describes itself 這是一種商業協作工具，自稱是 Podcast as an effective means of connecting with prospective customers. 聯繫潛在顧客的有效方法。 Podcast Collabro Chatter claims that by providing a system that puts businesses in easy contact Collabro Chatter 聲稱，透過提供一個讓企業方便地聯繫 Podcast with potential customers, Collabro Chatter offers a genuine opportunity for companies 潛在顧客的系統，它真正為公司提供機會， Podcast to advance office productivity and efficiency. 提高辦公室生產力和效率。 Podcast And increased productivity and efficiency is music to any boss's ears, in these or any times. 無論在現在還是任何時候，提高生產力和效率，都是老闆最樂意聽到的事。 Podcast Well, that's it. What do you think, Roland? 好，播完了。Rowland，你怎麼看？ Podcast He makes some good points, but I don't think email's going to disappear. 他有些論點不錯，但我不認為電郵會消失。 Podcast I mean, people could maybe use less email, 人們也許會少用一點電郵， Podcast but they'll still use it to receive more, like, personal messages. 但仍然會用它接收較個人的訊息， Podcast You know, private stuff. 就是私人的內容。 Podcast That's always going to be a big concern for people. 這一直會是大家很關心的事情， Podcast You know, privacy. 就是私隱。 Podcast So, I don't know. I can't see it myself. 所以，我不太肯定。我自己看不到那會發生。 Podcast I actually found what he said really, really interesting. 其實我覺得他所說的非常、非常有趣。 Podcast I mean, doing business using social networking. 就是利用社交網絡做生意。 Podcast Sounds like great fun. 聽起來很好玩。 Podcast I might even go into business myself. 我甚至可能自己去做生意。 Narrator That is the end of Task 4. 任務四完結。 Narrator You now have two minutes to complete your answers to Task 4 你現在有兩分鐘時間完成任務四的答案， Narrator and to tidy up all your other answers. 並整理其餘所有答案。 Narrator Art B. 乙部。 網上系統播客 Cherry 和朋友 Rowland 正在收聽關於網上系統的播客。請一邊聆聽，一邊在空格填寫資料。播客摘要部分，每個空格不得超過三個英文詞。 播客摘要 最近一份美國報告：2010–2011 年，網頁電郵使用跌幅最大的是 歲的人。網頁電郵定義為透過 存取的電郵。報告亦指出 使用電郵的情況增加。社交網站的使用 增加。Mark Zuckerberg（Facebook 創辦人）認為電郵可能會 。Facebook 的重大優點：可以在 使用短訊、電郵或即時訊息。很多大型機構已由內部電郵系統轉用 。轉用原因： 。 社交網絡系統的優點，例如 Collabro Chatter。 在 方面更有效；並提高 及 。 指出 Rowland 和 Cherry 對播客內容的感受，每人只選一項。Rowland： 。Cherry： 。選項：Amused＝覺得好笑；Annoyed＝惱怒；Bored＝沉悶；Confused＝困惑；Enthusiastic＝熱切感興趣；Sceptical＝懷疑。

entries.title: Airport traveller survey
entries.text: The research team leader, Linda Lee, is interviewing a traveller in the airport departure hall. She has asked you to help fill in the interview form below. Write the information in the spaces according to the traveller’s answers. One space has been filled in for you as an example. Survey Sheet Type of traveller (Tick ONE box only.) business pleasure other Length of journey (Tick ONE box only.) long short medium Travel details Number of trips made each year Usual destination(s) Singapore Comments on the airport environment/facilities Likes Dislikes Singapore airport is … Hong Kong. (Tick ONE box only.) better than worse than the same as Reasons given: Narrator Task 1. 任務一。 Narrator The research team leader, Linda Lee, is interviewing a traveller in the airport departure hall. 研究組組長 Linda Lee 正在機場離境大堂訪問一位旅客。 Narrator She has asked you to help fill in the interview form below. 她請你協助填寫下方的訪問表格。 Narrator Write the information in the spaces according to the traveller's answers. 請根據旅客的回答，在空格填上資料。 Narrator One space has been filled in for you as an example. 其中一格已填好作例子。 Narrator You now have 30 seconds to study the task. 你現在有三十秒時間閱讀題目。 Narrator At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers. 任務結束後，你將有一分鐘時間整理答案。 Airport survey Excuse me, my name's Linda Lee and I work for the airport authority's research division. 打擾一下，我叫 Linda Lee，在機場管理局的研究部工作。 Airport survey We're trying to find out what travellers think of the facilities here. 我們想了解旅客對這裡設施的看法。 Airport survey Would you mind if I asked you a few questions? 介意我問你幾個問題嗎？ Airport survey Not at all. My flight's been delayed several hours, so I have all the time in the world. 完全不介意。我的航班延誤了幾小時，所以我有的是時間。 Airport survey You look very smartly dressed. Am I right in thinking you're on a work-related trip? 你穿得很整齊。我猜你是出差，對嗎？ Airport survey Well, thanks. But no, I'm not. 謝謝，但不是。 Airport survey I usually dress smartly because it gives you a better chance of being upgraded to business or first class if the plane is overbooked. 我通常穿得整齊，因為如果飛機超額訂位，這樣較有機會獲升級到商務艙或頭等艙。 Airport survey Clever. I've never thought of that. 真聰明，我從沒想過這一點。 Airport survey So you're heading off for a nice holiday somewhere. 所以你是去某個地方度假吧？ Airport survey I wish I were. Unfortunately, my mother, she lives in the UK, has been taken ill, so I'm going home to see her. 我倒希望如此。可惜住在英國的媽媽生病了，所以我要回家探望她。 Airport survey Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. So you know what to tick there, Chris? 很抱歉聽到這個消息。Chris，你知道應該勾選哪項了吧？ Airport survey Well, I guess you've already answered my second question, which is about the length of your flight. 我想你已回答了第二題，就是航程長短。 Airport survey London is quite a distance, isn't it? 倫敦相當遠，對吧？ Airport survey He can say that again. Though I still think doing the trip in 13 hours is something of a miracle. 可不是嘛。不過我還是覺得十三小時就能飛到，簡直有點像奇蹟。 Airport survey And how often do you fly each year? Is it just once or twice? 你每年乘搭飛機多少次？只有一兩次嗎？ Airport survey Oh, no. I fly way more than that. I have to do a lot of travelling for work, so I reckon probably about 10 to 12 trips a year. 不，比那多得多。我工作上經常要出行，估計每年大約十至十二次。 Airport survey Wow, up to a dozen trips a year? That's a lot. And do you fly to the UK often? 每年多達十二次？真不少。你常飛往英國嗎？ Airport survey Not really. This is the first time in years, actually. I can't bear the weather, you know. 不太常。其實這是多年來第一次。我受不了那裡的天氣。 Airport survey I prefer Thailand for my holidays, so I fly to Bangkok several times a year. Bangkok's so close. 我度假較喜歡去泰國，所以一年飛曼谷幾次。曼谷很近。 Airport survey I also go to Singapore for business quite frequently. And as my daughter's studying in Australia, I fly to Sydney quite often. 我也經常到新加坡公幹。而且女兒在澳洲讀書，所以我常飛悉尼。 Airport survey Er, that's S-Y, not S-I. You spelt it wrong. 是 S-Y，不是 S-I。你拼錯了。 Airport survey Oh, Chris, just copy it from the flight information up there. Chris，直接從上方航班資料顯示屏抄下來吧。 Airport survey Now, what do you most like about the environment of this airport? I mean, the layout, the design, that kind of thing. 你最喜歡這機場環境的哪些地方？例如布局、設計之類。 Airport survey Well, firstly, I really appreciate the daylight. 首先，我很欣賞這裡的天然日光。 Airport survey Daylight? 日光？ Airport survey Yes. So many airports are all closed in and gloomy. They make you feel like you're in a plane already. 對。很多機場封閉又陰暗，讓人覺得好像已經坐進飛機。 Airport survey But all these windows, they make it seem as if you're outside. It's very thoughtful of the designers. 但這裡那麼多窗戶，讓你感覺像身處戶外。設計師考慮得很周到。 Airport survey Another thing I like is that there's plenty of lounge space. 我還喜歡這裡有充足的候機室空間。 Airport survey What do you mean by lounge space? 你說候機室空間，是什麼意思？ Airport survey Well, take the seats we're sitting on in this lounge, for example. There's a big space between each row. 例如我們現在坐着的座椅，每排之間的空間很大。 Airport survey Some airports cram all the passengers together while they're waiting, so they're all hot and bothered before they even get on the plane. 有些機場讓候機旅客擠在一起，還未登機就已又熱又煩躁。 Airport survey That's a good point. 說得有道理。 Airport survey And a third thing I like is the moving walkways. Airports are getting bigger and bigger, but not all of them have moving walkways. 第三樣我喜歡的是自動行人道。機場越來越大，但不是每個都有自動行人道。 Airport survey Sometimes you have to walk for miles to get to the boarding gate or the immigration desk. 有時你要走很遠，才能到登機閘口或入境檢查櫃枱。 Airport survey I know what you mean. London airport is especially bad. 我明白。倫敦機場尤其糟糕。 Airport survey Let me ask you about the things you don't like now. What are the things that you think could be improved? 現在談談你不喜歡的地方。你覺得什麼地方可以改善？ Airport survey Well, I have to say the shops are often overcrowded. There are plenty of them, but really not enough space to move around them comfortably. 我得說，商店經常擠滿人。店舖很多，但裡面的空間不足，不能舒適地走動。 Airport survey Another thing is, there's no post office in the transit lounge. I've got a whole bunch of checks I need to send here and nowhere to post them. 另外，轉機候機室沒有郵局。我有一大疊支票要寄，卻找不到地方投寄。 Airport survey That's a nuisance. We'll have to do something about that. 真不方便。我們得想辦法處理。 Airport survey Oh, and I suppose one more thing is the trolleys are too small. 還有一點，就是手推車太小。 Airport survey That's T-R-O-L-L-E-Y, Chris. Chris，trolley 拼作 T-R-O-L-L-E-Y。 Airport survey I don't mean the trolleys in the check-in hall. I mean the transit lounge ones. 我不是指辦理登機手續大堂的手推車，而是轉機候機室裡的。 Airport survey You'd better specify that, Chris. He means only the transit lounge trolleys. Chris，最好寫清楚，他只指轉機候機室的手推車。 Airport survey Finally, what I'd like to do is ask you to compare Hong Kong with Singapore airport, which is one you say you go to quite often. 最後，想請你比較香港和新加坡機場，你說你經常去那裡。 Airport survey So would you say Singapore airport is better, worse, or about the same as regards facilities? 就設施而言，你覺得新加坡機場較好、較差，還是差不多？ Airport survey I'm afraid I'd have to say I like Singapore airport more. Yeah, it still has the edge over everywhere else. 恐怕我得說，我較喜歡新加坡機場。它仍然比其他地方略勝一籌。 Airport survey And what is it that makes it superior to Hong Kong? Anything in particular? 有什麼令它比香港優勝？有具體例子嗎？ Airport survey Well, for one thing it has more greenery. You know, potted palms, flowers. There's even a garden. Yeah, more greenery. 第一，它有更多綠化，例如盆栽棕櫚、花卉，甚至有個花園。對，更多綠化。 Airport survey Right, more greenery. 好，更多綠化。 Airport survey And another thing is it has a movie theatre. You know, a cinema where you can watch free movies. 另一點是有電影院，可以看免費電影。 Airport survey Wow, that's great. Well, thanks for taking the time to talk to us. 真棒。謝謝你抽時間跟我們交談。 Airport survey My pleasure. 不用客氣。 Airport survey And I hope you can find something to occupy yourself for the next few hours. 希望你能找到事情，打發接下來幾小時。 Airport survey In the meantime, put your business card in our lucky drawer hat. You could at least win some DVDs for yourself. 現在不妨把名片放進抽獎帽子，至少有機會贏一些 DVD。 Narrator That's the end of task one. You now have one minute to tidy up your answers. 任務一完結。你現在有一分鐘時間整理答案。 Narrator Task two. Linda is now interviewing another traveller about what facilities or features would be important in a new lounge area that is being planned at the airport. 任務二。Linda 現在訪問另一位旅客，詢問機場擬建的新候機室應有哪些重要設施或特色。 機場旅客調查 研究組組長 Linda Lee 正在機場離境大堂訪問一位旅客。她請你協助填寫下方訪問表。請根據旅客的回答，在空格填上資料。其中一格已作例子填好。 調查表 旅客類型（只勾選一格）：business＝商務；pleasure＝休閒旅遊；other＝其他。 航程長短（只勾選一格）：long＝長途；short＝短途；medium＝中程。 旅程資料。每年出行次數： 。常到的目的地： ／新加坡／ 。 對機場環境及設施的意見。喜歡的地方： 、 、 。不喜歡的地方： 、 、 。 新加坡機場與香港相比是……（只勾選一格）：better than＝較好；worse than＝較差；the same as＝一樣。 所提出的理由： ； 。

entries.title: A new airport lounge
entries.text: Linda is now interviewing another traveller about what facilities or features would be important in a new lounge area that is being planned at the airport. Listen to the traveller’s answers and rank the facilities in order of how important she thinks they are. Then note down her reasons and, finally, write the letter for the facility/feature in the correct boxes 1–6. Ranking the facilities: Put numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 to indicate how important each facility is. Use each number ONCE only. 1 = the most important; 5 = the least important. Plants Toilets Coffee shop Internet corner Children’s play area Reason(s) given for the traveller’s choice of facilities/features Facility/feature Reason(s) Plants Toilets Coffee shop Internet corner Children’s play area Plan of new lounge area Put letters A–F to indicate which facility/feature should go where. Original lounge plan with walkway, boarding gate, windows and positions 1–6 Plan answers Position on plan Facility / feature 1 2 3 4 5 6 Narrator Task two. Linda is now interviewing another traveller about what facilities or features would be important in a new lounge area that is being planned at the airport. 任務二。Linda 現在訪問另一位旅客，詢問機場擬建的新候機室應有哪些重要設施或特色。 Narrator Listen to the traveller's answers and rank the facilities in order of how important she thinks they are. 請聆聽旅客的回答，按她認為的重要程度排列設施。 Narrator Then note down her reasons. And finally, write the letter for the facility feature in the correct boxes one to six on page five. 然後記下她的理由。最後，把設施或特色的字母填入第五頁第1至6號位置的正確方格。 Narrator You now have 30 seconds to study the task. At the end of the task, you'll have one minute to tidy up your answers. 你現在有三十秒時間閱讀題目。任務結束後，你將有一分鐘時間整理答案。 Airport lounge interview Excuse me, madam. My name's Linda Lee and I work for the airport authority. Are you waiting for the London flight? 女士，打擾一下。我叫 Linda Lee，在機場管理局工作。你是在等倫敦的航班嗎？ Airport lounge interview Yeah, it's been delayed and I have no idea how to fill the time. 對，航班延誤了，我不知道怎樣打發時間。 Airport lounge interview Well, perhaps you could spare a few moments to look at this plan for a new lounge area which we're intending to build. 那麼，能否花一點時間看看我們打算興建的新候機室計劃？ Airport lounge interview We'd really appreciate your comments on it. We'll be including all the facilities and features on this list and would like you first of all to rank them in order of how important you think they are. 我們很想聽取你的意見。清單上的設施和特色都會加入，首先請按你認為的重要程度排序。 Airport lounge interview OK, let's have a look at them. 好，讓我看看。 Airport lounge interview Hmm. Well, I notice you have a coffee there. Would you say that a coffee shop was the most important thing to have in the lounge? 我看到你在喝咖啡。你會說咖啡店是候機室最重要的設施嗎？ Airport lounge interview Well, it certainly helps, especially when you have to wait all day for your plane. But I'd say it was of average importance, really. 它確實有幫助，尤其要等一整天才能上機時。不過我覺得它的重要程度只是中等。 Airport lounge interview So you'd put it in the middle of the scale. 所以你會把它排在中間。 Airport lounge interview Sure. As far as I'm concerned, toilets are the main requirement. I always get nervous before a flight and need to, you know. 當然。對我而言，廁所是最重要的。我每次飛行前都會緊張，需要去……你明白吧。 Airport lounge interview So what do you think is the least important facility? 那你認為最不重要的設施是什麼？ Airport lounge interview I guess it has to be the children's play area. No. Wait a minute. If you've got kids, I suppose you'd really appreciate something like that. 我想是兒童遊樂區。不，等等。如果有小朋友，我想會很欣賞這種設施。 Airport lounge interview Let's say the internet corner. Yeah, the computer nerds meeting point. Well, you can tell I'm not an online sort of person. 就選上網區吧，就是電腦迷聚腳的地方。看得出來，我不是那種愛上網的人。 Airport lounge interview But you'd rate the children's play area as a better facility to have than a coffee shop, would you? 但你會覺得兒童遊樂區比咖啡店更值得設置，對吧？ Airport lounge interview Oh, no. I prefer coffee to kids. At least with a coffee, you can chuck it away if you don't like it. I'm only joking. 不，我寧願要咖啡，不要小朋友。至少咖啡不喜歡還可以丟掉。我只是開玩笑。 Airport lounge interview So that leaves greenery as number two. I mean, plants. You rate that very highly, do you? 那麼第二名就是綠化，也就是植物。你對它的評價很高？ Airport lounge interview Yes. Yes, I suppose I do. Do you have any particular reason for that? 對，我想是的。有特別原因嗎？ Airport lounge interview Yes. I think greenery, or plants, whatever you want to call it, adds color and freshness to a lounge. 有。我覺得綠化或植物，隨你怎樣稱呼，都能為候機室添上色彩和清新感。 Airport lounge interview It adds color and freshness. Make a note of that, Chris. And what about toilets? Why did you put them at the top of your scale? 增加色彩和清新感。Chris，記下來。那廁所呢？為什麼排第一？ Airport lounge interview Because the toilets on the plane are often cramped and smelly. 因為飛機上的廁所經常狹窄又難聞。 Airport lounge interview Not on every airline, surely. Most toilets on airplanes are cramped, but they're seldom smelly. 不會每家航空公司都這樣吧。飛機廁所通常狹窄，但很少有臭味。 Airport lounge interview Well, I always travel cheap, so I don't expect the best. 我總是坐廉價航班，所以不期望最好。 Airport lounge interview Perhaps you shouldn't drink so much coffee before you get on. 也許你登機前不該喝那麼多咖啡。 Airport lounge interview Having coffee shops is a must, though. Everyone knows the coffee on planes tastes bad, and it's always lukewarm. You know, never hot enough. 不過咖啡店是必需的。大家都知道飛機上的咖啡不好喝，而且總是不冷不熱，就是不夠燙。 Airport lounge interview That's not always true. 不一定總是這樣。 Airport lounge interview It is. Show me an airline where the coffee isn't rubbish. 就是這樣。告訴我哪家航空公司的咖啡不糟糕吧。 Airport lounge interview All right. Let's move on to the Internet corner, and let's try not to be rude about people who love computers. 好，繼續談上網區，也盡量別對喜歡電腦的人不禮貌。 Airport lounge interview Well, the reason I use computers is that most people use their own devices. 談到電腦，我的理由是大部分人都使用自己的裝置。 Airport lounge interview You mean their own devices like smartphones and tablets? 你指智能電話和平板電腦等自己的裝置？ Airport lounge interview Yeah, everyone seems to have them, and they're all connected to the Internet. 對，似乎人人都有，而且全都能上網。 Airport lounge interview Okay, good reason. 好，這理由不錯。 Airport lounge interview Now, how about this last one here? 現在談最後一項。 Airport lounge interview The children's play area. Why did you put it second from bottom on the scale? 兒童遊樂區。為什麼你把它排在倒數第二？ Airport lounge interview I guess because there are good and bad reasons for having one. 因為設置它有好處，也有壞處。 Airport lounge interview If you're a parent, the good reason is a play area helps kids use up their energy. 如果你是家長，好處是遊樂區讓孩子消耗精力。 Airport lounge interview Younger kids especially have so much energy, and it's better to use up some of it before they get on the plane. 尤其年幼孩子精力充沛，上飛機前最好先消耗一點。 Airport lounge interview A reason not to have a play area is that, of course, kids can be noisy, 不設遊樂區的理由，當然是孩子可能很吵， Airport lounge interview and the last thing other passengers want is a bunch of noisy kids playing while they're waiting to get on the plane. 其他旅客等候登機時，最不想遇到一群吵鬧的小朋友在旁玩耍。 Airport lounge interview It just adds to the tension. 這只會增加緊張感。 Airport lounge interview Okay. That's really helpful. 好，這很有幫助。 Airport lounge interview Now, there's just one more thing I'd like you to look at before we let you go. 在你離開前，還有一樣東西想請你看看。 Airport lounge interview This is a floor plan of the new lounge area. 這是新候機室的平面圖。 Airport lounge interview Now, thinking about what you've said already, where would you position the plants, the ferns, palms and things? 考慮剛才談過的，你會把植物，例如蕨類、棕櫚等放在哪裡？ Airport lounge interview Oh, without a doubt, in the middle. It would create a sort of avenue effect. 毫無疑問，在中間，可以營造一種林蔭大道的效果。 Airport lounge interview Yeah, right down the center there. 對，沿正中央排列。 Airport lounge interview Okay. Chris, just write the letter A there. 好，Chris，在那裡寫字母 A。 Airport lounge interview And I guess you'd put the toilets here, yes? 我猜你會把廁所放這裡，對吧？ Airport lounge interview Sure. Right by the gate. They should be the closest thing to the gate, in fact. 當然，就在閘口旁。事實上，它應該是最靠近閘口的設施。 Airport lounge interview There we go. 好了。 Airport lounge interview And the coffee shop. Where would you put that? 咖啡店呢？會放在哪裡？ Airport lounge interview Again, very close to the gate. Somewhere convenient, like there, at the end of the walkway, 同樣要很近閘口，找個方便的位置，例如這裡，走道末端， Airport lounge interview and with a window so you can see the view while you're drinking. 而且有窗，讓人喝咖啡時欣賞景色。 Airport lounge interview Let Chris just make a note of that. 讓 Chris 記下來。 Airport lounge interview And what's this? 這是什麼？ Airport lounge interview Ah, sleeper chairs. You haven't mentioned those before. 睡眠躺椅？之前沒提過。 Airport lounge interview Ah, they're a new kind of reclining chair, which allows you to sleep if you have a long wait ahead, 這是一種新式可調躺椅，等候時間長時可以睡一會兒， Airport lounge interview or you're transferring from another long flight. 或剛坐完另一段長途航班、正在轉機時使用。 Airport lounge interview I see, erm, a sort of first-class lounge seat. 明白，就是類似頭等候機室座位。 Airport lounge interview Well, I think the obvious place would be on the other side of the plants from the gate. 我想最明顯的位置，是植物另一邊、與閘口相對的地方。 Airport lounge interview You don't really want people staring at you sleeping while they're waiting. 你不會希望自己睡覺時，有候機的人盯着你看。 Airport lounge interview You've got lots of privacy here, and a window to look through too. 這裡很有私隱，還有窗可以向外看。 Airport lounge interview Good points. And now the last two things. 好理由。現在最後兩項。 Airport lounge interview I'm afraid the internet corner has already been confirmed as part of the plan, 恐怕上網區已確定會納入計劃， Airport lounge interview so would you put it in the actual corner on the bottom to the right there? 那麼你會把它放在右下方那個真正的角落嗎？ Airport lounge interview No, I think that space would be better reserved for the play area. 不，我覺得那個位置最好留給遊樂區。 Airport lounge interview It's away from where most of the passengers sit, so they wouldn't be disturbed by the noise. 它遠離大多數旅客的座位，他們就不會被噪音騷擾。 Airport lounge interview The computer nerds can take the area next to it at the foot of the plan. 電腦迷可以用旁邊那一區，就是平面圖最下方。 Airport lounge interview Serves them right. 他們活該。 Airport lounge interview Well, thank you so much. 非常感謝你。 Airport lounge interview It's been fun talking to you, and I hope you find something to occupy yourself while you wait for your flight. 和你聊天很愉快，希望你能找到事情打發候機時間。 Airport lounge interview No problem. I guess I'll just go and have another coffee. 沒問題。我想我會再喝一杯咖啡。 Airport lounge interview Oh, one more thing. 還有一件事。 Airport lounge interview Put your business card or your name and address in our lucky drawer hat, 把名片或者姓名地址放進我們的抽獎帽子， Airport lounge interview and you could win a prize worth up to two thousand dollars. 就有機會贏得價值高達二千元的獎品。 Airport lounge interview Okay, here goes. 好，放進去。 Narrator That's the end of task two. 任務二完結。 Narrator You now have one minute to tidy up your answers. 你現在有一分鐘時間整理答案。 新機場候機室 Linda 現在訪問另一位旅客，詢問機場擬建的新候機室應有哪些重要設施或特色。請按她認為的重要程度排列設施，再記下理由；最後，把設施或特色的字母填入第1至6號位置的正確方格。 為設施排序：填入1、2、3、4、5，表示每項設施的重要程度，每個數字只可使用一次。1＝最重要；5＝最不重要。依題目次序：Plants＝植物；Toilets＝廁所；Coffee shop＝咖啡店；Internet corner＝上網區；Children’s play area＝兒童遊樂區。 旅客選擇各設施或特色的理由。植物： 。廁所： 。咖啡店： 。上網區： 。兒童遊樂區： ； 。 新候機室平面圖 填入 A–F，表示各項設施或特色應設在哪個位置。 原平面圖。walkway＝走道；Boarding Gate＝登機閘口；window＝窗戶。保留圖中第1至6號位置，依錄音判斷設施，並在下方作答。 平面圖答案。位置1： ；位置2： ；位置3： ；位置4： ；位置5： ；位置6： 。選項：A 植物；B 廁所；C 咖啡店；D 睡眠躺椅；E 兒童遊樂區；F 上網區。

entries.title: Food and drink questionnaire
entries.text: Linda has now invited a traveller to try some of the items available from the restaurants and coffee shops at the airport. Put a tick (✓) if the traveller likes the food, a cross (✗) if he doesn’t, or a question mark (?) if he’s not sure. The items may not be mentioned in the same order as they appear in the Question-Answer Book. One space has been filled in for you as an example. Food and drink questionnaire Food / drink Like (✓) / Dislike (✗) / Not sure (?) Reason(s) it’s really filling (example) Narrator Task three. 任務三。 Narrator Linda has now invited a traveller to try some of the items available from the restaurants and coffee shops at the airport. Linda 現在邀請一位旅客，試吃機場餐廳及咖啡店提供的部分食品。 Narrator Put a take if the traveller likes the food. 如果旅客喜歡食物，請加剔號。 Narrator A cross if he doesn't. 不喜歡便加交叉， Narrator Or a question mark if he's not sure. 不肯定便加問號。 Narrator The items may not be mentioned in the same order as they appear in the question answer book. 食品提及的次序，未必與答題簿上的排列相同。 Narrator One space has been filled in for you as an example. 其中一格已填好作例子。 Narrator You now have thirty seconds to study the task. 你現在有三十秒時間閱讀題目。 Narrator At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers. 任務結束後，你將有一分鐘時間整理答案。 Traveller interview Hello, we're from the airport authority, and we're wondering if you'd like to try some of the food and drink items available at our various restaurant outlets. 你好，我們來自機場管理局，想問你有沒有興趣試試各間食肆供應的食物和飲品。 Traveller interview Sure. I was just thinking how hungry I was. 當然，我剛才正覺得很餓。 Traveller interview Okay, let's start with the hot dog then. 好，先從熱狗開始。 Traveller interview Take a bite of that. It's from Hot Dog Express. 咬一口吧，這是 Hot Dog Express 的。 Traveller interview Well, I'm not a big hot dog fan, but I'll give it a go. 我不太喜歡熱狗，不過可以試試。 Traveller interview No, I can't say this one persuades me either. 不，這一款也沒有令我改觀。 Traveller interview No, that's not for me. It's too salty. 不，不合我口味，太鹹了。 Traveller interview Make a note of that, Chris. Too salty. Chris，記下：太鹹。 Traveller interview Alright, perhaps you should choose something you like the look of. 好，不如由你選一款外觀看起來喜歡的。 Traveller interview Well, that tortilla looks pretty good. I love Mexican food usually. 那個墨西哥薄餅卷看起來不錯。我通常很喜歡墨西哥菜。 Traveller interview Mmm, that's really good. And it's got loads in it. 嗯，真的很好吃，而且餡料很多。 Traveller interview What's so special about it? 它有什麼特別？ Traveller interview Well, it's spicy. Really hot. And I don't mean heat hot. 很香辣，非常辣。我指的不是溫度燙。 Traveller interview And the other thing is, it's really filling. You know, tortillas fill you up. 還有就是很飽肚。墨西哥薄餅卷很能填飽肚子。 Traveller interview Not like some other snacks which just leave you feeling hungry. 不像有些小食，吃了還是覺得餓。 Traveller interview Okay, that's from Viva Tortilla, which has only recently opened. 好，這來自剛開業不久的 Viva Tortilla。 Traveller interview Now, what about these chicken skewers from the food court? 那麼美食廣場的這些雞肉串呢？ Traveller interview How do you feel about those? 你覺得怎樣？ Traveller interview Let me just take one there. 讓我拿一串。 Traveller interview Hmm. My sauce? Well, that's tasty. 嗯，醬汁？這個很好吃。 Traveller interview Yeah, finger-licking good, as they say. 對，就像人們說的，好吃到舔手指。 Traveller interview Just write down tasty sauce, Chris. Chris，寫下「醬汁美味」就可以。 Traveller interview The chicken's a bit stringy, though. 不過雞肉有點粗韌、纖維多。 Traveller interview Oh, very stringy. I could floss my teeth with that. 非常粗韌。我都能用它來當牙線清潔牙縫了。 Traveller interview Oh, what a horrible idea. 這個想法真可怕。 Traveller interview Stringy is just G-Y, Chris. Not G-E-Y. Chris，stringy 結尾是 G-Y，不是 G-E-Y。 Traveller interview Oh, and I guess you should put a question mark in the second column. 我想你應該在第二欄加問號。 Traveller interview I'll have a word with the manager of the Sate House. 我會跟 Sate House 的經理談談。 Traveller interview In the meantime, perhaps you'd like to wash that down 現在也許你可以喝一點東西送下去， Traveller interview with a sip of our tropical smoothie from the Waikiki bar. 試一口 Waikiki 酒吧的熱帶水果冰沙。 Traveller interview Mmm, lovely. That hit the spot. It's very cool. 嗯，真棒，正合我意。很冰涼。 Traveller interview Icy cool, in fact, and refreshing. 事實上是冰冰的，而且很清新。 Traveller interview Yeah, it really makes you feel refreshed. 真的讓人感到精神一振。 Traveller interview Oh, you've missed out on the sushi. 你還未試壽司。 Traveller interview Actually, I was trying to avoid that. 其實我是故意避開它。 Traveller interview Japanese isn't my favourite cuisine. 日本菜不是我最喜歡的菜系。 Traveller interview I'll have a go, though. 不過我會試試。 Traveller interview Oh, sorry. Do you have a napkin? 不好意思，有餐巾嗎？ Traveller interview Oh, that's not for me. It's much too fishy. 不合我口味，魚腥味太重。 Traveller interview Well, it is raw fish. 它畢竟是生魚。 Traveller interview Yes, I know. But there's fish, which I usually like, 我知道，但魚是一回事，我通常喜歡吃魚， Traveller interview especially with chips. Then there's, well, fishy, which I don't. 尤其配薯條；可是魚腥味是另一回事，我不喜歡。 Traveller interview How about a mouthful of cupcake to take the taste away? 吃一口紙杯蛋糕，去掉那股味道如何？ Traveller interview I won't say no. 我不會拒絕。 Traveller interview Well? 怎樣？ Traveller interview Mmm, just a minute. Mouthful. 等一下，嘴裡還有一大口。 Traveller interview Well, I can't decide, really. 其實我決定不了。 Traveller interview It's light. Not at all heavy, which is a good thing. 它很鬆輕，一點也不厚重，這是優點。 Traveller interview But otherwise a bit tasteless. 但除此之外有點沒味道。 Traveller interview Yeah, tasteless is the word I'd use. 對，我會用「沒味道」來形容。 Traveller interview Make a note of both of those, Chris. Chris，兩點都記下。 Traveller interview I can't make up my mind if I like it or not. 我不能決定到底喜不喜歡。 Traveller interview Well, thanks ever so much for helping us with the survey. 非常感謝你協助我們做調查。 Traveller interview Now, if you'd like to put your business card into our lucky drawer hat... 現在，如果你願意把名片放進抽獎帽子…… Narrator That's the end of task three. 任務三完結。 Narrator You now have one minute to tidy up your answers. 你現在有一分鐘時間整理答案。 Narrator Task four. 任務四。 食物及飲品問卷 Linda 邀請一位旅客試吃機場餐廳及咖啡店供應的部分食品。喜歡的填剔號（✓），不喜歡的填交叉（✗），不肯定的填問號（?）。錄音提及食品的次序未必跟答題簿相同。其中一格已作例子填好。 食物及飲品問卷。欄目：食物／飲品；喜歡（✓）／不喜歡（✗）／不肯定（?）；理由。圖1熱狗： ；理由 。圖2雞肉串： ；理由 、 。圖3壽司： ；理由 。圖4墨西哥薄餅卷： ；理由 ；很飽肚（例子）。圖5紙杯蛋糕： ；理由 、 。飲品圖水果冰沙： ；理由 、 。

entries.title: Airport Survey Report
entries.text: You are now attending a meeting of the research team with Linda and two other researchers called Simon and Sandy who are reporting on the survey results. Based on what you hear in the conversation between Linda and the researchers, fill in the spaces in the report below with details of the services and recommendations for improvements. Remember to pay attention to spelling and grammar. One space has been filled in for you as an example. Airport Survey Report About of the travellers we interviewed were by the food and beverage services provided. At least a of them had not used the restaurants so they expressed no preference (example) . The rest gave the following suggestions: such as , and food. Other facilities travellers requested were: More , such as a and a . More , such as a and an . On the whole, travellers seemed very with the facilities at the airport. Narrator Task four. 任務四。 Narrator You are now attending a meeting of the research team with Linda 你現在和 Linda 一起出席研究組會議， Narrator and two other researchers called Simon and Sandy, 還有兩位研究員 Simon 和 Sandy， Narrator who are reporting on the survey results. 他們正在報告調查結果。 Narrator Based on what you hear in the conversation between Linda and the researchers, 請根據 Linda 與研究員的對話， Narrator fill in the spaces in the report below with details of the services 在下方報告空格填上服務的詳情， Narrator and recommendations for improvements. 以及改善建議。 Narrator Remember to pay attention to spelling and grammar. 記得注意拼字和文法。 Narrator One space has been filled in for you as an example. 其中一格已填好作例子。 Narrator You now have one minute to study the task. 你現在有一分鐘時間閱讀題目。 Narrator At the end of the task, you will have two minutes to tidy up your answers. 任務結束後，你將有兩分鐘時間整理答案。 Survey report meeting All right, Chris, I've completed the framework of the report for you. 好，Chris，我已為你完成報告的框架。 Survey report meeting You just have to fill in the details 你只須填上細節， Survey report meeting and remember to pay attention to grammar and spelling when you're doing that. 填寫時記得注意文法和拼字。 Survey report meeting Simon has counted all our responses and come up with some percentage figures Simon 已統計所有回覆，算出一些百分比， Survey report meeting along with travellers' comments. 並整理旅客的意見。 Survey report meeting So how did the travellers rate our eating establishments, Simon? Simon，旅客怎樣評價我們的食肆？ Survey report meeting Pretty well, actually. 其實評價相當好。 Survey report meeting About 60% said they found the services impressive. 大約百分之六十說服務令人留下深刻印象。 Survey report meeting Well, it's always good to impress people. 能給人留下好印象總是好事。 Survey report meeting Then 15% weren't happy with the range. 然後百分之十五對種類選擇不滿。 Survey report meeting 50%? 百分之五十？ Survey report meeting No, 15. 不，十五。 Survey report meeting And 25% hadn't used any restaurants, 另有百分之二十五沒有使用過任何餐廳， Survey report meeting so they couldn't say which ones they preferred. 所以說不出偏好哪一家。 Survey report meeting Okay, don't bother writing about the 15%, Chris. 好，Chris，不用寫那百分之十五。 Survey report meeting We'll let people work that out for themselves. 讓大家自己算出來吧。 Survey report meeting All right, let's move on to suggestions. 現在談建議。 Survey report meeting How do people think our food choices can be improved? 大家認為我們的食物選擇可以怎樣改善？ Survey report meeting Well, first off, we should reduce the number of fast food outlets. 首先，我們應該減少快餐店數目。 Survey report meeting Less in the way of hamburgers, hot dogs, fried chicken and other salty snacks. 少一點漢堡包、熱狗、炸雞和其他鹹味小食。 Survey report meeting Yes, I have to agree. We do need to reduce them. 對，我得同意，確實需要減少。 Survey report meeting There's too much emphasis on fast food. Go on. 現在太偏重快餐。請繼續。 Survey report meeting Another request was to increase medium-priced restaurants. 另一個要求是增加中等價位的餐廳。 Survey report meeting Either you have very cheap fast food outlets 現在不是很便宜的快餐店， Survey report meeting or upmarket eateries that are too pricey. 就是價錢太貴的高級食肆。 Survey report meeting Increasing medium-priced restaurants would help balance things out. 增加中等價位餐廳，有助取得平衡。 Survey report meeting Fair enough. That's worth noting down. 合理，值得記下。 Survey report meeting Finally, many felt we should provide a greater variety of food. 最後，很多人認為應提供更多元化的食物。 Survey report meeting And what did they mean by greater variety? 他們說更多元化，是指什麼？ Survey report meeting Well, different cuisines, really. 就是不同菜系。 Survey report meeting Many wanted Japanese food. 很多人想要日本菜。 Survey report meeting There is some available, but not really high-quality stuff. 現在有一些，但質素不算很高。 Survey report meeting There were also a lot of requests for Indian food, 也有很多人要求印度菜， Survey report meeting and not just from Indians. 而且不只是印度人。 Survey report meeting The Japanese and the Singaporeans love curry, 日本人和新加坡人都喜歡咖喱， Survey report meeting and so do many Westerners. 很多西方人也是。 Survey report meeting Any other requests? 還有其他要求嗎？ Survey report meeting Well, there were a few for Middle Eastern food, 有幾個人要求中東菜， Survey report meeting things like kebabs and falafels. 例如烤肉串和炸鷹嘴豆丸。 Survey report meeting Middle Eastern food has a whole range of possibilities. 中東菜有各式各樣的選擇。 Survey report meeting Interesting. 有趣。 Survey report meeting Okay, let's move on to other facilities now. 現在談其他設施。 Survey report meeting What sort of requests did the travellers make, Sandy? Sandy，旅客提出了什麼要求？ Survey report meeting Well, several people felt there should be more places of worship. 有幾位覺得應該增加宗教禮拜場所。 Survey report meeting Places of worship? 宗教禮拜場所？ Survey report meeting You mean like chapels, that sort of thing. 你指小教堂那類？ Survey report meeting We already have one of those. 我們已經有一個。 Survey report meeting Yes, but we don't have a Muslim prayer room, for example. 對，但例如穆斯林祈禱室，我們就沒有。 Survey report meeting Hmm, that's a bit of an oversight, really, isn't it? 這算是有點疏忽，對吧？ Survey report meeting Write it down, Chris. Chris，寫下來。 Survey report meeting You can spell Muslim either M-U-S-L-I-M Muslim 可以拼作 M-U-S-L-I-M， Survey report meeting or M-O-S-L-E-M, your choice. 或者 M-O-S-L-E-M，隨你選。 Survey report meeting Oh, and prayer is spelt P-R-A-Y-E-R. 還有 prayer 拼作 P-R-A-Y-E-R。 Survey report meeting Got that? 記下了嗎？ Survey report meeting Any more places of worship to add, Sandy? Sandy，還有其他禮拜場所要補充嗎？ Survey report meeting Well, I'm not sure of discounts, 我不肯定這算不算， Survey report meeting but someone suggested a meditation room. 但有人提議設立靜坐冥想室。 Survey report meeting I like that idea. 我喜歡這主意。 Survey report meeting Meditation's a good thing to do before you get on a plane, 登機前靜坐一下是好事， Survey report meeting and it's not only Buddhists who like to do it. 也不只有佛教徒才喜歡。 Survey report meeting It's definitely worth including in the report. 絕對值得放進報告。 Survey report meeting There were also a number of requests 還有不少人要求 Survey report meeting for more entertainment facilities. 增加娛樂設施。 Survey report meeting Such as? 例如什麼？ Survey report meeting Well, I'm not sure if everyone would count 我不肯定是否每個人都會把 Survey report meeting this as an entertainment facility, 這個算作娛樂設施， Survey report meeting but more than one person suggested a game centre. 但不止一個人建議設立遊戲中心。 Survey report meeting Hmm, I don't think the airport authority 我不覺得機場管理局 Survey report meeting would be keen to give space to a game centre, 會很願意撥地方給遊戲中心， Survey report meeting but I guess we ought to make a note of it. 但我想我們應該記下來。 Survey report meeting Something they might be more happy to go for 他們可能較樂意接受的， Survey report meeting is an art gallery. 是美術館。 Survey report meeting Many travellers said they'd seen them in other airports 很多旅客說在其他機場看過， Survey report meeting and thought it was a great idea. 覺得是很好的主意。 Survey report meeting Yes, I can see why. 對，我能理解。 Survey report meeting There's something very relaxing about art galleries. 美術館總有種令人放鬆的感覺。 Survey report meeting OK, to sum up then, travellers at the airport 好，總結來說，機場旅客 Survey report meeting felt that the facilities provided were mostly satisfactory. 認為所提供的設施大致令人滿意。 Survey report meeting I'd say that was about right, yes. 對，我想這樣說相當準確。 Survey report meeting So let's increase someone's level of satisfaction even more. 那麼，讓我們再提高某個人的滿意程度吧。 Survey report meeting Would you like to pull the name out of the lucky drawer hat, Sandy? Sandy，你可以從抽獎帽子裡抽出一個名字嗎？ Survey report meeting OK, sure. 可以。 Survey report meeting Oh, it's Mr Pot of Jesterville, USA. 是美國 Jesterville 的 Pot 先生。 Survey report meeting His first name's not Jack by any chance, is it? 他的名字該不會剛巧是 Jack 吧？ Survey report meeting That's right. How did you know that? 沒錯，你怎麼知道？ Narrator That is the end of task four. 任務四完結。 Narrator You now have two minutes to complete your answers to task four 你現在有兩分鐘時間完成任務四的答案， Narrator and to tidy up all your other answers. 並整理其餘所有答案。 Narrator Part B. Open your data file at page two. 乙部。請把資料檔案翻到第二頁。 機場調查報告 你正與 Linda 及研究員 Simon、Sandy 出席研究組會議，兩位研究員正在報告調查結果。請根據對話，在報告空格填上服務詳情和改善建議。記得注意拼字和文法。其中一格已作例子填好。 機場調查報告 受訪旅客中，約 對餐飲服務感到 。至少 的旅客未曾使用餐廳，所以沒有表達偏好（例子）。 其餘旅客提出以下建議： ； ； ，例如 、 及 食物。 旅客要求的其他設施包括： 更多 ，例如一間 及一間 。更多 ，例如一個 及一間 。整體而言，旅客似乎對機場設施非常 。

entries.title: Planning the YouTube project
entries.text: You are going to listen to a meeting where Helen, Mike and John discuss with Helen’s teacher, Ms. Stanley, the background and ideas for the project. Listen to the meeting and write the missing information in the spaces provided in the note sheet. The first has been provided as an example. Meeting Notes First YouTube clip by: 23rd (example) February Deadline of whole project: Project duties Person’s Name Duties editing, writing scripts recording, maintaining and fixing equipment directing, interviewing, writing scripts Ideas for YouTube clips Themes Comments Hong Kong’s Wild Animals Ask for help. Email address: Unusual Need to find someone to contact. Important Places in Hong Kong Use that Ms. Stanley found. of Hong Kong to arrange an interview. Budget $2000: Use money for stationery, food, transport and . N.B. Need to collect from office. Narrator Task 1 任務一。 Narrator You are going to listen to a meeting where Helen, Mike and John discuss with Helen's teacher, 你將聆聽一場會議，Helen、Mike 和 John 會與 Helen 的老師 Narrator Miss Stanley, the background and ideas for the project. Stanley 老師，討論計劃的背景和構思。 Narrator Listen to the meeting and write the missing information in the spaces provided in the note sheet. 請聆聽會議，在筆記表提供的空格填上所缺資料。 Narrator The first has been provided as an example. 第一項已作例子提供。 Narrator You now have 30 seconds to study the task. 你現在有三十秒時間閱讀題目。 Narrator At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers. 任務結束後，你將有一分鐘時間整理答案。 Project meeting Good morning. 早安。 Project meeting Come in all of you and sit down. 大家請進，坐下吧。 Project meeting Now, Helen, can you introduce me to your friends? Helen，可以介紹一下你的朋友嗎？ Project meeting Well, this is John and this is Mike. 這位是 John，這位是 Mike。 Project meeting Hello, Miss Stanley. Stanley 老師，你好。 Project meeting Nice to meet you, Mike. 很高興認識你，Mike。 Project meeting Good morning, Miss Stanley. Stanley 老師，早安。 Project meeting Morning, John. 早安，John。 Project meeting Well, thanks for helping out. 謝謝你們幫忙。 Project meeting OK, let's get started, shall we? 好，開始吧？ Project meeting So I finalised the dates of the project. 我已敲定計劃的日期。 Project meeting You need to have the first YouTube clip completed in two weeks on the 23rd of February. 第一條 YouTube 影片要在兩星期後，也就是二月二十三日完成。 Project meeting That way we can spot any problems on the production side of things early on. 這樣我們就能及早發現製作方面的問題。 Project meeting Is the 23rd OK for everyone? 二十三日，大家都可以嗎？ Project meeting Yes, no problem. 可以，沒問題。 Project meeting Fine with me. 我也可以。 Project meeting Good. 好。 Project meeting Now, I'm giving you about three months to do all six of the YouTube clips. 我給你們大約三個月，完成全部六條 YouTube 影片。 Project meeting So that will be the 17th of May. 所以截止日期是五月十七日。 Project meeting I hope you guys are good at sticking to a deadline. 希望你們都能遵守期限。 Project meeting OK, let's move on to the next thing then, shall we? 好，談下一件事吧。 Project meeting Helen? Helen？ Project meeting Yes. 是。 Project meeting Tell me, who is doing what in this project? 告訴我，這個計劃由誰負責什麼？ Project meeting Yes, well, let's see. 好，讓我想想。 Project meeting I want to direct the clips and interview people. 我想負責導演及訪問。 Project meeting I'd love to direct something. 我很想嘗試執導。 Project meeting Oh, yes, I'll also be helping out John with writing scripts. 我也會幫 John 寫稿。 Project meeting That's good, because I'm going to need some help with the writing. 很好，因為寫稿方面我確實需要協助。 Project meeting Helen told me you'd done a bit of editing, John. Is that right? Helen 說你做過剪接，John，對嗎？ Project meeting That's right. I've done some editing before. I just hope I'll be able to manage. 對，以前做過一些剪接，希望我能應付。 Project meeting OK. Mike, what would you like to do? 好，Mike，你想負責什麼？ Project meeting I want to do the recording and look after the equipment. I've got a lot of experience. 我想負責拍攝及照顧器材。我有很多經驗。 Project meeting Mike is very good at fixing things. He even fixed my iPhone. Mike 很擅長維修，他連我的 iPhone 也修好了。 Project meeting Fixing stuff is easy. 修理東西很容易。 Project meeting So shall we have a look at the ideas you've come up with for the theme for all of the clips? 不如看看你們為整套影片想出的主題？ Project meeting Well, we have four ideas for the themes. The one I like most is Hong Kong's wild animals. 我們有四個主題構思，我最喜歡的是香港野生動物。 Project meeting I think that it's a topic not many people really know about, and there's a lot of wildlife in Hong Kong. 我覺得這題材不是很多人真正了解，而且香港有不少野生動物。 Project meeting Yes, I like that idea. Actually, come to think of it, I know someone who might be able to help you. 我喜歡這主意。說起來，我認識一個可能幫得上忙的人。 Project meeting He works in an animal shelter in the new territories. Maybe you could interview him. His name is Brad. 他在新界一間動物收容所工作，也許可以訪問他。他叫 Brad。 Project meeting Brad? B-R-A-D? Like the Hollywood actor? Brad？B-R-A-D，像那位荷里活演員？ Project meeting Yes, that's right. I've got his email address on my phone. Do you want me to text it to you? 對。我手機裡有他的電郵地址，要傳短訊給你嗎？ Project meeting Just tell me it, and I'll type it into mine now. 直接告訴我，我現在輸入自己的手機。 Project meeting OK, here it is. The email address is wildtamer at gmail.com. 好，在這裡。電郵地址是 wildtamer@gmail.com。 Project meeting Is that W-I-L-D-T-A-M-E-R? 是 W-I-L-D-T-A-M-E-R 嗎？ Project meeting That's right. All one word. W-I-L-D-T-A-M-E-R. And Gmail is spelt G-M-A-I-L. 沒錯，連成一個字。W-I-L-D-T-A-M-E-R。Gmail 拼作 G-M-A-I-L。 Project meeting Oh, I know how to spell Gmail. 我知道 Gmail 怎樣拼。 Project meeting OK, that's enough of that, I think. So, does anyone want to suggest other ideas? 好，這部分說得夠了。還有人想提其他構思嗎？ Project meeting To be honest, I actually prefer my idea. I was thinking of interviewing people who have unusual hobbies. 老實說，我比較喜歡自己的主意，就是訪問有不尋常嗜好的人。 Project meeting You know, like people who dress up as cartoon characters, or go hunting UFOs. 例如打扮成卡通人物，或去尋找不明飛行物體的人。 Project meeting Hmm, unusual hobbies. Maybe. Have you got somebody in mind to interview? 不尋常嗜好？也許吧。有想到訪問誰嗎？ Project meeting Well, no, not really. 其實沒有。 Project meeting Well, you'd need to think about somebody to contact then. 那你就需要想想可以聯絡誰。 Project meeting I know I've mentioned it before, but I like to suggest that we make some clips about important places in Hong Kong. 我知道之前提過，但我想建議拍一些關於香港重要地方的影片。 Project meeting Oh, not this again. 又來了。 Project meeting Thank you, Mike. Can I hear your idea, John? 謝謝，Mike。John，可以聽聽你的構思嗎？ Project meeting Well, I thought it would be nice to tell people about places in Hong Kong that are important in some way. 我覺得介紹香港一些在某方面有重要意義的地方會不錯， Project meeting You know, historically or culturally. 例如歷史或文化方面。 Project meeting Well, that seems like a very good idea, too. I actually found an article about this the other day. 這也似乎是個好主意。前幾天我剛好找到一篇相關文章。 Project meeting You could use it to add some interesting information. 你們可以用它補充一些有趣資料。 Project meeting Oh, I have one more idea. I think it could be really amazing. 我還有一個主意，我覺得會很精彩。 Project meeting Yes. 是什麼？ Project meeting We could do something about ghosts of Hong Kong. 我們可以拍香港鬼故事。 Project meeting Hmm, oh no, not ghosts. 不，不要鬼故事。 Project meeting Well, I'm not sure about that. It's going to be difficult to arrange an interview with a ghost. 我不太肯定。要安排訪問一隻鬼，恐怕很困難。 Project meeting Ha, very difficult. 哈哈，非常困難。 Project meeting So, which theme do you think we should choose? 你覺得我們應該選哪個主題？ Project meeting Well, wild animals and important places in Hong Kong seem to have a lot of potential. 香港野生動物和重要地方這兩個題目似乎很有發展空間。 Project meeting But why don't you guys discuss it more and give me your final decision later? 不如你們再討論一下，稍後告訴我最後決定？ Project meeting Now, before we finish for today, I have some good news for you. 今天結束前，還有個好消息。 Project meeting You have been given a budget of $2,000 for the project. 這個計劃獲得二千元預算。 Project meeting Wow, $2,000? What can we spend it on? 二千元？可以用來買什麼？ Project meeting Oh, just little things, you know, like stationery or food when you're out recording. 一些小東西，例如文具，或外出拍攝時買食物。 Project meeting Oh, and transport. Maybe gifts. 還有交通費，也許禮物。 Project meeting Gifts? 禮物？ Project meeting Yes, gifts for people you interview. It could be a drink or some food, just to say thank you. 對，送給受訪者的禮物，可以是飲品或食物，表達謝意。 Project meeting Okay? 明白嗎？ Project meeting Oh, and one more thing. Don't forget to pick up the smart card from the office so you can get into the studio when you need to. 還有一件事，別忘了到辦公室拿智能卡，這樣有需要時就可以進入錄影室。 Project meeting No problem. I'll get the smart card now. 沒問題，我現在去拿智能卡。 Project meeting Thanks for your help, Miss Stanley. Bye. 謝謝你幫忙，Stanley 老師。再見。 Project meeting Thank you, Miss Stanley. Bye-bye. 謝謝，Stanley 老師。再見。 策劃 YouTube 製作計劃 你將聆聽一場會議，Helen、Mike 和 John 會與 Helen 的老師 Stanley 老師討論計劃背景和構思。請在筆記表的空格填寫所缺資料，第一項已作例子提供。 會議筆記 第一條 YouTube 影片須於二月二十三日（例子）前完成。整個計劃的截止日期： 。 計劃分工。欄目：姓名／職責。 ：剪接、寫稿。 ：拍攝、保養及維修器材。 ：導演、訪問、寫稿。 YouTube 影片構思。欄目：主題／意見。香港野生動物：請 協助；電郵地址 。不尋常的 ：需要找一個人聯絡。香港的重要地方：使用 Stanley 老師找到的 。香港的 ：要安排訪問很 。 預算 二千元：可用於文具、食物、交通及 。注意：需要到辦公室領取 。

entries.title: Choosing the YouTube theme
entries.text: Helen, Mike and John are now discussing which theme to choose for their YouTube clips. Listen to their discussion and fill in the missing information in the spaces provided in the table. ✓ Yes · ✗ No · ? Maybe Themes and opinions Theme Name View Reasons Wild animals in Hong Kong Helen ✓ Most people are interested in animals because they can be or . Wild animals in Hong Kong Mike Animals move in different ways. Wild animals in Hong Kong John ✓ Animals are . Important places in Hong Kong Helen Most students . Important places in Hong Kong Mike ✗ Places don’t move — . Important places in Hong Kong John ✓ Can find exciting stories about each place. Famous people in Hong Kong Helen ? Probably too busy to speak to us. Famous people in Hong Kong Mike Famous people in Hong Kong John ✗ Only meet famous people students are not interested in, e.g. . Hong Kong Helen ✗ This theme is too common. Same theme Mike Same theme John ? All of them are , especially the . Narrator At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers. 任務結束後，你將有一分鐘時間整理答案。 Helen, Mike and John Right. Miss Stanley says she wants us to choose a theme for the six YouTube clips. 好，Stanley 老師要我們為六條 YouTube 影片選一個主題。 Helen, Mike and John We need to tell her by the end of today and explain the reasons for our choice. 今天結束前要告訴她，並解釋選擇的原因。 Helen, Mike and John I've got the new list of themes we've come up with and we'll just go through them and vote yes, no, or maybe for each one. 我有我們新擬的主題清單，逐項討論，再投贊成、反對或也許吧。 Helen, Mike and John Um, Mike, can you just remind me of the themes again so I can write them down? Mike，可以再說一次有哪些主題，讓我寫下來嗎？ Helen, Mike and John Sure. So we have wild animals in Hong Kong, important places in Hong Kong, famous people in Hong Kong, and Hong Kong comics. 當然，有香港野生動物、香港重要地方、香港名人，以及香港漫畫。 Helen, Mike and John Let's start with wild animals, then. I'm putting a tick for myself. 先從野生動物開始，我會給自己填剔號。 Helen, Mike and John I like this theme a lot. I think most people are interested in animals, you know, because they can be cute or scary. 我很喜歡這主題。我想大多數人對動物有興趣，因為牠們可以很可愛，也可以很可怕。 Helen, Mike and John Are there cute animals in Hong Kong? I mean, there are plenty of scary insects and snakes here, but cute animals? Really? 香港有可愛的動物嗎？嚇人的昆蟲和蛇倒是不少，但可愛的動物，真的有嗎？ Helen, Mike and John Well, there are deer in Hong Kong. They're quite cute. 香港有鹿，牠們挺可愛的。 Helen, Mike and John Well, okay, I suppose. 好吧，也許是。 Helen, Mike and John What's the matter, Mike? Don't you like this theme? Mike，怎麼了？你不喜歡這主題？ Helen, Mike and John No, I really want to do this theme. Animals will be good to film. They move in different ways. 不，我真的很想做這主題。動物很適合拍攝，牠們有不同的移動方式。 Helen, Mike and John That makes some very good subjects for this kind of project. 所以很適合成為這類計劃的拍攝對象。 Helen, Mike and John Well, put me down for a yes. I love animals. But what I think is good about wild animals is that different animals are colorful. 我也投贊成，我喜歡動物。不過我覺得野生動物的優點，是不同動物色彩豐富。 Helen, Mike and John That's true. We want our videos to be colorful. Okay, so let's move on to important places in Hong Kong. 沒錯，我們希望影片色彩豐富。好，接着談香港的重要地方。 Helen, Mike and John Personally, I'm not sure about this one. Sorry, John. I know you suggested this theme. 我個人對這個主題不太肯定。不好意思，John，我知道是你提議的。 Helen, Mike and John Why? What's the problem with it? 為什麼？有什麼問題？ Helen, Mike and John I don't know. It's just that I think most students know about these places already. What do you think, Mike? 我不知道，只是覺得大多數學生已經知道這些地方。Mike，你怎麼看？ Helen, Mike and John I'm a no. Places and buildings don't move, and that makes them dull to look at on video. I think it would be a very dull theme overall. 我反對。地方和建築物不會移動，拍成影片看起來很沉悶。我覺得整體上會是個很悶的主題。 Helen, Mike and John Like you say, Helen, students know about these places already. 正如 Helen 所說，學生已經認識這些地方。 Helen, Mike and John Well, we could go beyond what most students know already and find exciting stories about each place. I think... I mean, we could... 我們可以超越學生已知的內容，為每個地方找些精彩故事。我覺得……我們可以…… Helen, Mike and John Let it go, John. We've decided it's too boring. Okay, let's have a look at the next theme. Famous people. Right, Helen? 算了吧，John，我們已決定它太沉悶。看看下一個主題，名人，對吧，Helen？ Helen, Mike and John Yeah, that's right. I'm also a maybe on this one. I reckon most famous people would probably be too busy to speak to us. 對，這個我也選「也許」。我想大多數名人會太忙，沒有時間跟我們說話。 Helen, Mike and John I think this is a great idea, actually. It would be good for the school's image. 其實我覺得這是好主意，對學校形象有幫助。 Helen, Mike and John Good for the school's image? How does that work, Mike? 對學校形象有幫助？Mike，為什麼？ Helen, Mike and John Well, I don't know. 我不知道。 Helen, Mike and John I think the only people we're going to get to interview are people that students are not interested in. Helen's right. We're not going to get movie stars or pop stars. We're just going to get some boring old writer. 我想我們能訪問到的，只會是學生沒興趣的人。Helen 說得對，我們找不到電影明星或流行歌手，只會找到一些沉悶的老作家。 Helen, Mike and John Okay, John. Fine. We all get your point. 好，John，我們都明白了。 Helen, Mike and John Let's look at the last theme and finish up. 看看最後一個主題，然後結束吧。 Helen, Mike and John Well, this is another one of my suggestions. Hong Kong Comics. I hope you guys will say yes for this one. I love comics. 這也是我其中一個建議，香港漫畫。希望你們會贊成這個，我很喜歡漫畫。 Helen, Mike and John To be honest, I think that this theme is too common. I want to do something a bit different. 老實說，我覺得這主題太常見，我想做點不同的。 Helen, Mike and John But the drawings are amazing. 但畫得很精彩啊。 Helen, Mike and John Okay, the artwork is amazing, Mike. But aren't these comics just for boys? Mike，畫功是很精彩，但這些漫畫不都是給男生看的嗎？ Helen, Mike and John Not all of them. I know what you mean, though, Helen. I'm not sure about this idea. Many of the comics seem to be very similar. 不是全部。不過 Helen，我明白你的意思。我對這個構思不太肯定，很多漫畫似乎很相似。 Helen, Mike and John Similar? Similar how? 相似？哪方面？ Helen, Mike and John Well, especially the stories. The stories are nearly always the same. 尤其是故事，故事幾乎總是一樣。 Helen, Mike and John Well, that's it then. It looks like wild animals of Hong Kong is our theme, yeah? 那就這樣吧，看來我們的主題是香港野生動物，對嗎？ Helen, Mike and John Okay, I guess so. 好，我想是吧。 Narrator That is the end of task two. You now have one minute to tidy up your answers. 任務二完結。你現在有一分鐘時間整理答案。 選擇 YouTube 主題 Helen、Mike 和 John 正在討論 YouTube 影片應選哪個主題。請聆聽討論，在表格空格填上所缺資料。 ✓＝贊成；✗＝反對；?＝也許。 主題及意見。欄目：主題／姓名／看法／理由。香港野生動物：Helen 贊成，大部分人對動物感興趣，因為牠們可以 或 ；Mike ，動物有不同的移動方式；John 贊成，動物 。香港重要地方：Helen ，大部分學生 ；Mike 反對，地方不會移動，所以 ；John 贊成，可以找到每個地方的精彩故事。香港名人：Helen 也許，名人大概太忙，沒有時間跟我們交談；Mike ，理由 ；John 反對，只能訪問學生沒興趣的名人，例如 。香港 ：Helen 反對，主題太常見；Mike ，理由 ；John 也許，它們全都 ，尤其是 。

entries.title: A wild boar incident
entries.text: Helen is now interviewing Neelay Shah who works for the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (the AFCD). Complete the notes by filling in the missing information in the spaces provided. Interviewee Item Details Name Neelay Shah Position Length of service 12 years Background to incident Item Details Location Lok Ma Chau When 3 or 4 weeks ago Items damaged T.V. A wild boar A Wild Boar Morning Mr Tang’s dog barked at something. The boar the dog. Mr Tang was knocked over and . Before lunch Mr Tang’s son arrived and he tried to scare the boar by . The boar bit his leg and he needed stitches and . Lunchtime / Afternoon The AFCD arrived. They put inside the house which had inside it. They didn’t catch the boar because it . In the evening The police and a arrived. He the boar and the boar . The next day They . Narrator Task three. Helen is now interviewing Nili Shah, who works for the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, the AFCD. 任務三。Helen 正在訪問在漁農自然護理署（漁護署，AFCD）工作的 Neelay Shah。 Narrator Complete the notes by filling in the missing information in the spaces provided. 請在空格填上所缺資料，完成筆記。 Narrator You now have 30 seconds to study the task. At the end of the task, you will have one and a half minutes to tidy up your answers. 你現在有三十秒時間閱讀題目。任務結束後，你將有一分半鐘時間整理答案。 Helen and Neelay Shah So, Mr. Shah, you work for the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department. Is that right? Shah 先生，你在漁護署工作，對嗎？ Helen and Neelay Shah Yes, that's right. As a senior officer, I've been a senior officer here for six years now and in the AFCD for nearly 12 years. 對。我是高級主任，擔任這職位已六年，在漁護署則接近十二年。 Helen and Neelay Shah Wow, 12 years? That is a long time. I bet you have some interesting stories about wild animals. 十二年？真久。你一定有不少關於野生動物的有趣故事。 Helen and Neelay Shah I've certainly seen a few strange things in my time, yes. The most exciting one that happened recently was maybe three, four weeks ago. 我工作期間確實見過幾件奇怪的事。最近最驚險的一件，大概發生在三、四星期前。 Helen and Neelay Shah I was just finishing my lunch when my supervisor called me and told me to get a team over to Lakhmachao, you know? 我剛吃完午飯，主管就打電話，叫我帶隊去落馬洲。 Helen and Neelay Shah He said some villagers were under attack from a wild boar, and it was trapped in their house, and they couldn't get it out. 他說有村民受到野豬襲擊，野豬被困在屋內，他們趕不走牠。 Helen and Neelay Shah Gosh, so did the boar do much, like, damage or anything? 天啊，野豬有造成很多破壞嗎？ Helen and Neelay Shah Damage? That boar was like a bomb. It totally wrecked that villager's house. You know, we had a look around after we'd caught it. 破壞？那頭野豬像炸彈一樣，徹底摧毀了村民的家。我們捉到牠後查看了一遍。 Helen and Neelay Shah I remember seeing that it had knocked over a large TV and cracked the screen. Heaven knows how much that cost to replace. 我記得看到牠推倒了一部大電視，螢幕破裂，不知道更換要花多少錢。 Helen and Neelay Shah Oh, and then, then it trashed the kitchen cupboard when it was trying to get at some food. These animals are so powerful, you know. 接着，牠為了找食物，把廚房櫥櫃也破壞了。這種動物力量很大。 Helen and Neelay Shah Oh, no, that's terrible. 天啊，太糟了。 Helen and Neelay Shah That's only half of it. I guess that boar must have eaten a lot of food in the cupboard because it then soiled an expensive carpet. 這才說了一半。我想牠在櫥櫃吃了很多東西，因為之後牠把一張昂貴地毯弄髒了。 Helen and Neelay Shah You know, one of those fancy carpets from India. And if that wasn't enough, that boar actually tried to eat the curtains. 就是那種來自印度的精美地毯。還不止這樣，牠甚至想吃掉窗簾。 Helen and Neelay Shah It ripped the curtains off their railings and chewed them to pieces. 牠把窗簾從軌道扯下，咬得粉碎。 Helen and Neelay Shah So can you tell me the whole story from the beginning? Who were the villagers? 可以從頭說說整件事嗎？那些村民是誰？ Helen and Neelay Shah The people in question were a Mr. Tang and his son. Mr. Tang lived on his own in one of those small market farms that you get in the new territories. 當事人是鄧先生和他的兒子。鄧先生獨居，在新界常見的那種小型菜園農場生活。 Helen and Neelay Shah So how did the boar get in? 那野豬怎樣進去的？ Helen and Neelay Shah Very dramatically. Very dramatically indeed. At around 11am, Mr. Tang said he'd noticed his dog barking at something out by the forest near his vegetable field. 非常戲劇化。鄧先生說早上約十一點，他發現狗正對着菜田旁森林那邊的某樣東西吠叫。 Helen and Neelay Shah The boar, right? 就是野豬，對吧？ Helen and Neelay Shah Yes, that's right. Now, usually his dog scares off the boars. But not this time, though. 對。通常他的狗會把野豬嚇走，但這次不是。 Helen and Neelay Shah He told me that all of a sudden his dog gave out a really loud yelp and came running back towards the house as fast as it could. 他說狗突然大聲尖叫，然後用最快速度往屋子跑回來。 Helen and Neelay Shah And chasing the dog was this huge brown boar. Well, that dog jumped straight through the door and into the house. 追着狗的是一頭巨大的棕色野豬。狗直接跳進門，跑入屋內。 Helen and Neelay Shah And Mr. Tang, seeing what was happening, tried as quickly as he could to shut the door. But, oh dear. Oh dear. Awful, really. 鄧先生看到情況，趕緊想把門關上。但，唉，實在太糟糕。 Helen and Neelay Shah Awful? What happened? 太糟糕？發生什麼事？ Helen and Neelay Shah Well, that boar hit the door so hard that it threw Mr. Tang off his feet and he landed badly on the floor, breaking his arm. 野豬用力撞門，把鄧先生撞倒。他重重摔在地上，弄斷了手臂。 Helen and Neelay Shah Poor, poor old man. He was in such pain when we saw him. It wasn't until we got him an ambulance that he realized his arm was broken. 可憐的老人。我們見到他時，他痛得很厲害，直到我們替他召救護車，他才知道手臂骨折。 Helen and Neelay Shah Oh my goodness, that's terrible. Falling over and breaking his arm like that? 天啊，跌倒還弄斷手臂，真的很糟。 Helen and Neelay Shah Yeah. Then he told me that he ran out of the house and shut the door and locked it. He called his son over to help. 對。他接着說自己跑出屋外，關門上鎖，再叫兒子來幫忙。 Helen and Neelay Shah But when his son arrived just before lunch, he also got injured. 但兒子在午飯前到達後，也受了傷。 Helen and Neelay Shah His son got injured? How? 兒子也受傷？怎樣受傷？ Helen and Neelay Shah I think the son thought it was just a little boar and that he could scare it out of the house easily. 我想兒子以為只是小野豬，可以輕易嚇牠出屋。 Helen and Neelay Shah He went in carrying a big stick and tried to scare the boar by banging the floor with his stick. But that boar wasn't scared at all. 他拿着大木棒進去，用木棒敲地板，想嚇走野豬，但牠一點也不怕。 Helen and Neelay Shah It charged straight at the son and bit the son's leg. That poor fellow had to get stitches for his cuts in the end and an injection. 牠直接衝向兒子，咬傷他的腿。最後他不但傷口要縫針，還要打針。 Helen and Neelay Shah Ouch. So when did you get there? 哎呀。那你們什麼時候到場？ Helen and Neelay Shah Well, we got there about lunchtime, around one or two. We had a cage with us and we put some dog food inside the cage. 約午飯時間，一、兩點。我們帶了籠子，在裡面放狗糧。 Helen and Neelay Shah Then, very carefully and quietly, we put the cage inside the house and waited for the boar to go into the cage and trap itself. 然後非常小心、安靜地把籠子放進屋，等野豬走進去，把自己困住。 Helen and Neelay Shah It wouldn't go near the cage. It just ate the food it could find in the kitchen. 牠根本不肯靠近籠子，只吃在廚房找到的食物。 Helen and Neelay Shah Sounds like a pretty clever boar. 聽起來真聰明。 Helen and Neelay Shah Yeah. Well, by the evening, we gave up waiting and decided to call the police for extra help. 對。到了晚上，我們不再等下去，決定叫警察來幫忙。 Helen and Neelay Shah The police? What? Were they going to arrest the boar for breaking and entering? 警察？要以爆竊罪拘捕野豬嗎？ Helen and Neelay Shah Yeah. Very funny. No, they brought a vet with them who had a special kind of gun that fires tranquilizer darts. 真好笑。不是，他們帶了一位獸醫，配備發射麻醉針的特製槍。 Helen and Neelay Shah Or tranquilizer darts, those things that put animals to sleep. 麻醉針，就是讓動物睡着的東西。 Helen and Neelay Shah Yes. It puts the animal to sleep for a while. But it's not always very safe. Sometimes it can kill the animal. 對，讓動物睡一會兒。但不一定很安全，有時可能會殺死動物。 Helen and Neelay Shah So did it work? 那成功了嗎？ Helen and Neelay Shah The vet missed the first time, but managed to shoot the boar the second time. 獸醫第一槍沒射中，但第二槍成功射中了野豬。 Helen and Neelay Shah After a few minutes, we went in and put the sleeping boar in the cage. You wouldn't believe how heavy it was. 幾分鐘後，我們進屋，把睡着的野豬放進籠子。你真難以想像牠有多重。 Helen and Neelay Shah The next day, we let it go back into the wild. 第二天，我們把牠放回野外。 Helen and Neelay Shah You let the boar go? Not next to Mr. Tang's farm, I hope. 把牠放了？希望不是放在鄧先生農場旁吧。 Helen and Neelay Shah No, no. We took it to a country park a few kilometers away. 不是，我們把牠帶到幾公里外的一個郊野公園。 Helen and Neelay Shah Wow. That really was an exciting story. Thanks so much again, Mr. Shah. I can't wait to tell the others. 真是驚險的故事。再次謝謝你，Shah 先生。我迫不及待想告訴其他人。 Helen and Neelay Shah I'm glad you liked it. I must say, I'm looking forward to seeing your YouTube clip when it's finished. 很高興你喜歡。我也很期待看到你們完成的 YouTube 影片。 Narrator That is the end of task three. You now have one and a half minutes to complete your answers. 任務三完結。你現在有一分半鐘時間完成答案。 野豬事件 Helen 正在訪問漁農自然護理署（AFCD）的 Neelay Shah。請在空格填上所缺資料，完成筆記。 受訪者。姓名：Neelay Shah。職位： 。服務年資：十二年。 事件背景。地點：落馬洲。時間：三至四星期前。損毁物品：電視、 、 、 。 一頭野豬。 早上 鄧先生的狗對着某樣東西吠叫。野豬 那隻狗。鄧先生被撞倒，並且 。 午飯前 鄧先生的兒子到達，嘗試透過 嚇走野豬。野豬咬傷他的腿，他需要縫針及 。 午飯時間／下午 漁護署到達。他們把 放進屋內，裡面有 。他們沒有捉到野豬，因為牠 。 晚上 警察及一位 到達。他 野豬，野豬就 。 第二天 他們 。

entries.title: Stray animals in Hong Kong
entries.text: John and Helen have completed one of their YouTube clips. John is now showing the finished clip to Ms. Stanley. Listen and fill in the missing information from the YouTube clip and then complete the comments Ms. Stanley makes after seeing the clip. Stray animals Topic Details Types of stray animals unwanted pets escaped animals from zoos Problems caused by stray dogs Greatest concern: because of the risk of Most recent concern: Harm to Dealing with stray dogs Methods Description Comments Keep the animal for 4 days and then put it down. This method hasn’t resulted in . This method is also considered . Sometimes the dog is put down because the AFCD . TNR Animal is: de-sexed / neutered vaccinated Part of the animal’s to show it has been through TNR. HK Government thinks the public would not . Dogs are less likely to be aggressive. They can’t after TNR. Ms. Stanley’s feedback Ms. Stanley’s criticisms Ms. Stanley’s suggestions for improvement It’s not It’s too Indicate how John feels after hearing Ms. Stanley’s comments. Tick ONE box only. Excited Pleased Annoyed Confused Disappointed Narrator Task four. John and Helen have completed one of their YouTube clips. 任務四。John 和 Helen 已完成其中一條 YouTube 影片。 Narrator John is now showing the finished clip to Miss Stanley. John 現在把完成的影片給 Stanley 老師看。 Narrator Listen and fill in the missing information from the YouTube clip and then complete the comments Miss Stanley makes after seeing the clip. 請聆聽並填上影片中所缺的資料，再完成 Stanley 老師觀看後提出的意見。 Narrator You now have one minute to study the task. At the end of the task, you will have two minutes to tidy up your answers. 你現在有一分鐘時間閱讀題目。任務結束後，你將有兩分鐘時間整理答案。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley OK, John. I'm looking forward to this. What's this part about? 好，John，我很期待。這部分是關於什麼？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley This part is an interview with Robbie Lowe. He works for an animal charity in the new territories. 這部分是訪問 Robbie Lowe，他在新界一間動物慈善機構工作。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley We asked him about the problem of stray animals in Hong Kong. I got Helen to interview him this time. 我們問他香港流浪動物的問題，這次由 Helen 負責訪問。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley OK. Let's have a look at it, shall we? 好，一起看看吧。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley So Robbie, can you tell us about some of the problems caused by stray animals in Hong Kong? Robbie，可以告訴我們香港流浪動物引起哪些問題嗎？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Well, Helen, first of all, we need to consider what we mean by stray animals. Helen，首先要想清楚我們所說的流浪動物是什麼。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Actually, there are three different types of stray animals. 其實流浪動物有三種不同類型。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley One type that is common here are unwanted pets, things like cats and dogs mostly. 這裡常見的一種，是被主人棄養的寵物，主要是貓狗。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley The next most common type would be abandoned farm animals. 第二常見的是被遺棄的農場動物。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley You mean like those wild cows in Sai Kong? 例如西貢的野牛？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Yes, that's a good example, yes. 對，那是個好例子。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley The least common, but most interesting ones, are exotic species that have escaped from zoos. 最少見但最有趣的，是從動物園逃走的外來物種。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley If you explore the countryside of Hong Kong, you'll find all kinds of animals that were once owned by people but have now been left to roam wild. 如果探索香港郊野，就會發現各種曾有人飼養、如今被放任在野外遊走的動物。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley But most of the problems people have with stray animals are from dogs. 不過人們遇到的流浪動物問題，大部分來自狗。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Stray dogs are associated with several risks. 流浪狗涉及幾種風險。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley The greatest fear people have is from attacks. 大家最害怕的是受到襲擊。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Dog bites can be particularly nasty and can carry the risk of diseases, like rabies. 狗咬傷可以很嚴重，也可能傳播狂犬病等疾病。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Fortunately, attacks such as these by stray dogs are actually very rare. 幸好，流浪狗這類襲擊其實很少發生。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Stray dogs also make quite a mess. 流浪狗也會把環境弄得很髒亂。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Most recently, there have been concerns about the damage stray dogs do to the local wildlife. 最近，人們還關注流浪狗對本地野生動物造成的傷害。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley It is believed that dogs are responsible for the deaths of many local wild animals every year. 據信每年很多本地野生動物的死亡，都是狗造成的。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley And dogs will eat almost anything, so they pose a risk. 狗幾乎什麼都吃，所以構成威脅。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley What are the best ways of dealing with stray dogs, then? 那麼應付流浪狗最好的方法是什麼？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Currently, there are two recognized methods for dealing with stray dogs. 目前有兩種獲認可的處理方法。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley But the Hong Kong government only practices the catch-and-kill policy. 但香港政府只採用「捕捉及殺死」政策。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley The catch-and-kill policy is as straightforward as it sounds. 這個政策正如名稱所示，非常直接。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley It does what it says. 就是字面上所說的做法。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Usually, officers from the AFCD will trap dogs that they find which appear to have no owner. 漁護署人員通常會捕捉那些看起來沒有主人的狗。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley They will then keep the animal for four days. 然後收容四天。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley And if it's not claimed, they will put the animal down. 如果沒有人認領，就會把動物人道毀滅。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley This policy may seem at first glance to make sense. 這政策乍看似乎有道理。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley But the rate that the animals are killed is basically the same as the natural death rate from disease and starvation. 但殺死動物的速率，基本上跟牠們因疾病及飢餓自然死亡的速率一樣。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley So it does not lead to a drop in the population of stray dogs overall. 所以整體上並沒有令流浪狗數量下降。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley In fact, in some places where this method has been carried out, there have been increases in the number of stray dogs. 事實上，有些採用這方法的地方，流浪狗數量反而上升。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley There are also some other disadvantages to this method. 這方法也有其他缺點。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Some of us think that it is cruel to animals that have already suffered. 有些人認為，對已受過苦的動物這樣做很殘忍。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Did you know that nearly 80% of the 10,000 stray dogs captured last year were destroyed? 你知道去年捕捉的一萬隻流浪狗中，接近八成都被人道毀滅了嗎？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley I mean, is this really how a civilized society deals with its unwanted pets? 文明社會真的該這樣處理被棄養的寵物嗎？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley There is also another disadvantage. 還有另一個缺點。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Sometimes the AFCD gets it wrong. 漁護署有時會出錯。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley In one case, a dog which had an identity microchip and had been registered was still put down because the AFCD had made a mistake. 曾有一隻已登記、植入身分晶片的狗，仍因漁護署犯錯而被人道毀滅。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley The alternative to this policy is what is called TNR, which means trap, neuter and return. 另一種政策叫 TNR，即捕捉、絕育及放回原處。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Basically, with this method, first, the stray dog is caught and then it is desexed, so it's no longer able to breed. 基本上，先捉住流浪狗，然後為牠絕育，令牠不能繁殖。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley It's then vaccinated against certain diseases, before being released at the place where it was originally found. 再接種疫苗預防某些疾病，然後放回原先找到牠的地方。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley I heard that with this method, they cut a bit of the dog's ear off. Is that right? 我聽說這方法會剪掉狗耳朵的一小部分，對嗎？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Yes, we do. I know it sounds a bit barbaric, but it's only a small bit of the dog's ear. 對。我知道聽起來有點野蠻，但只是很小的一部分。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley It seems a strange thing to do, but it's to show that it has been desexed and vaccinated, so they will know not to catch that dog again. 這樣做似乎奇怪，但目的是顯示牠已絕育及接種疫苗，讓人知道不用再捕捉同一隻狗。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley This is the current practice in the USA and the UK, and it has been shown to work quite effectively. 這是美國和英國現行的做法，而且證實相當有效。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley However, the government in Hong Kong doesn't want to use this method, because they think the public would be against it, as the dog would still be a nuisance. 但香港政府不想採用，因為認為市民會反對，畢竟狗仍可能滋擾公眾。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley We think this method has definite advantages, though, apart from just being a kinder way to deal with stray animals. 不過我們覺得這方法肯定有優點，除了較仁慈地對待流浪動物以外， Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley You see, once the animal has been desexed, it actually becomes much less aggressive. 動物絕育後，攻擊性其實會降低很多。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Plus, maybe the biggest advantage is that the dog can no longer breed, and so there will be a drop in the population over time. 還有，也許是最大的優點，就是狗無法再繁殖，所以隨時間過去數量會下降。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley That's really interesting. Thank you for taking the time to answer my questions. 很有意思，謝謝你抽時間回答我的問題。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley OK, can we just stop this here, John? John，可以在這裡先停一下嗎？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Yes, sure. So, what did you think? 可以。你覺得怎樣？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Hmm, I'm not sure. To be honest, it's a bit dull to watch at the moment. Let me make a few points and suggestions. 我不太肯定。老實說，目前看起來有點沉悶，讓我提幾點意見及建議。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley First, it's not visual enough. Remember, this is a video. It needs to be visually interesting. 首先，畫面不夠豐富。記住這是影片，視覺上需要有吸引力。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley For example, at the moment, you only have a picture of Robbie's head while he's talking, with the occasional reaction shot of Helen nodding her head. 例如現在只是 Robbie 說話的頭部畫面，偶爾穿插 Helen 點頭回應的鏡頭。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley You could make it more visual by putting in some shots of stray dogs. 可以加入一些流浪狗鏡頭，增加視覺內容。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Mmm, OK. I guess we can go back and film some stray dogs. 好，我想我們可以回去拍一些流浪狗。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley OK, what about the overall content? 好，整體內容方面呢？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Actually, that was going to be my second point. I think it is pretty interesting, but Robbie's definitely too biased. 這正是我想說的第二點。內容頗有趣，但 Robbie 的立場明顯太偏頗。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley I guess it is a bit unbalanced, looking at it right now. 現在這樣看，我想的確有點不平衡。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Have you thought about interviewing someone who has a different opinion? 有沒有想過訪問一位持不同意見的人？ Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley It would be nice to contrast Robbie's opinion with someone who disagrees. Maybe someone from the AFCD. 如果能把 Robbie 的意見跟反對者的意見作對照會很好，例如漁護署人員。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley OK. I'm sorry it's not very good now. We'll really try to do a better job for next time. 好，抱歉目前做得不太好。下次我們會努力做得更好。 Helen／John／Robbie Lowe／Ms Stanley Hey, don't worry, John. It's not bad. It just needs some work, that's all. 別擔心，John，不是很差，只是還需要修改而已。 Narrator That is the end of Task 4. You now have two minutes to complete your answers to Task 4 and to tidy up all your other answers. 任務四完結。你現在有兩分鐘時間完成任務四的答案，並整理其餘所有答案。 香港的流浪動物 John 和 Helen 已完成一條 YouTube 影片，John 正把成品給 Stanley 老師看。請根據影片填上所缺資料，再完成 Stanley 老師觀看後提出的意見。 流浪動物。類型：被主人棄養的寵物； ；從動物園逃走的動物。流浪狗造成的問題：最大關注是 ，因為有 的風險；最近的關注是對 造成傷害。 處理流浪狗。欄目：方法／說明／評論。 ：收容四天，然後人道毀滅。這方法沒有帶來 ；亦被認為 ；有時狗被人道毀滅，是因漁護署 。TNR：動物會被 、絕育、接種疫苗及 ；動物的 一小部分，用來顯示已接受 TNR。香港政府認為公眾不會 ；狗較不容易有攻擊性；接受 TNR 後不能 。 Stanley 老師的回饋。批評／改善建議。它不夠 ： 。它太 ： 。 指出 John 聽過 Stanley 老師的意見後有何感受，只勾選一格。Excited＝興奮；Pleased＝高興滿意；Annoyed＝惱怒；Confused＝困惑；Disappointed＝失望。

entries.text: The Chau family is searching on the internet and talking about things to do. Listen to their discussion and write the information in the spaces below.
